ui.key: |A large resort area in Seogwipo, Jeju. Hotels, beaches, waterfalls and museums are gathered here.
ui.ko: 제주 서귀포에 있는 대규모 관광 단지다. 호텔과 해변, 폭포, 박물관이 모여 있다.
ui.en: A large resort area in Seogwipo, Jeju. Hotels, beaches, waterfalls and museums are gathered here.

ui.key: |A large sports and resort complex in Pyeongchang, Gangwon. It has ski slopes and jumping hills and hosted events of the Pyeongchang Winter Olympics.
ui.ko: 강원 평창에 있는 대규모 스포츠·휴양 단지다. 스키장과 점프대가 있고 평창 동계올림픽 경기가 열린 곳이다.
ui.en: A large sports and resort complex in Pyeongchang, Gangwon. It has ski slopes and jumping hills and hosted events of the Pyeongchang Winter Olympics.

ui.key: |A large sports complex in Songpa-gu, Seoul. The main stadium, baseball park and gymnasium stand together and host matches and concerts.
ui.ko: 서울 송파구에 있는 대형 체육 시설 단지다. 주경기장, 야구장, 체육관이 모여 있어 경기와 공연이 열린다.
ui.en: A large sports complex in Songpa-gu, Seoul. The main stadium, baseball park and gymnasium stand together and host matches and concerts.

ui.key: |A large sports stadium in Suseong-gu, Daegu. It hosts football matches and concerts and was built as a venue for the 2002 World Cup.
ui.ko: 대구 수성구에 있는 대형 종합 경기장이다. 축구 경기와 공연 등이 열리며 2002년 월드컵 경기장으로 지어졌다.
ui.en: A large sports stadium in Suseong-gu, Daegu. It hosts football matches and concerts and was built as a venue for the 2002 World Cup.

ui.key: |A large temple at the foot of Hwangaksan in Gimcheon, North Gyeongsang. Tradition dates it to the Silla period, and it is one of the major temples of the Jogye Order.
ui.ko: 경북 김천 황악산 자락에 있는 큰 사찰이다. 신라 시대에 세워졌다고 전하며 불교 조계종의 중심 사찰 가운데 하나다.
ui.en: A large temple at the foot of Hwangaksan in Gimcheon, North Gyeongsang. Tradition dates it to the Silla period, and it is one of the major temples of the Jogye Order.

ui.key: |A large temple near the coast of Daepo-dong in Seogwipo, Jeju. Its imposing main hall stands out above the southern sea.
ui.ko: 제주 서귀포 대포동 바닷가 가까이에 있는 큰 사찰이다. 웅장한 대적광전이 눈에 띄고 제주 남쪽 바다를 내려다본다.
ui.en: A large temple near the coast of Daepo-dong in Seogwipo, Jeju. Its imposing main hall stands out above the southern sea.

ui.key: |A large temple on Yeongchuksan in Yangsan, South Gyeongsang, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It enshrines Buddha relics at the Geumgang Altar and is called the Buddha Jewel temple.
ui.ko: 경남 양산 영축산에 있는 큰 사찰로 유네스코 세계유산이다. 부처의 사리를 모신 금강계단이 있어 불보사찰로 불린다.
ui.en: A large temple on Yeongchuksan in Yangsan, South Gyeongsang, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It enshrines Buddha relics at the Geumgang Altar and is called the Buddha Jewel temple.

ui.key: |A large temple on the southern slope of Jirisan in Gurye, South Jeolla. It holds the national treasure Gakhwangjeon Hall among many cultural properties and is known for its red plum blossoms in spring.
ui.ko: 전남 구례 지리산 남쪽 자락에 있는 큰 사찰이다. 국보인 각황전을 비롯해 여러 문화유산이 있고 봄에는 홍매화로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A large temple on the southern slope of Jirisan in Gurye, South Jeolla. It holds the national treasure Gakhwangjeon Hall among many cultural properties and is known for its red plum blossoms in spring.

ui.key: |A large theme park in Yongin, Gyeonggi. It offers rides, a zoo and seasonal festivals.
ui.ko: 경기 용인에 있는 대형 테마파크다. 놀이기구와 동물원, 계절 축제가 있는 곳이다.
ui.en: A large theme park in Yongin, Gyeonggi. It offers rides, a zoo and seasonal festivals.

ui.key: |A large traditional market in Jegi-dong, Dongdaemun-gu, Seoul. Many stalls sell herbal medicine ingredients, dried seafood, vegetables and fruit.
ui.ko: 서울 동대문구 제기동에 있는 대형 전통시장이다. 한약재와 건어물, 채소와 과일 등을 파는 상점이 많다.
ui.en: A large traditional market in Jegi-dong, Dongdaemun-gu, Seoul. Many stalls sell herbal medicine ingredients, dried seafood, vegetables and fruit.

ui.key: |A large traditional market in Jung-gu, Daegu. It has many fabric, clothing and food stalls, and a night market is held there.
ui.ko: 대구 중구에 있는 큰 전통시장이다. 직물과 의류, 먹거리를 파는 가게가 많고 야시장도 열린다.
ui.en: A large traditional market in Jung-gu, Daegu. It has many fabric, clothing and food stalls, and a night market is held there.

ui.key: |A large urban park beside Seongsu-dong in Seongdong-gu. It has wide lawns, ponds and a deer enclosure, and lies close to the Han River.
ui.ko: 성동구 성수동 옆에 있는 대형 도시 숲이다. 넓은 잔디밭과 연못, 사슴 방사장이 있고 한강과도 가깝다.
ui.en: A large urban park beside Seongsu-dong in Seongdong-gu. It has wide lawns, ponds and a deer enclosure, and lies close to the Han River.

ui.key: |A large urban park in Busanjin-gu, Busan. It was converted from a former US military camp site and has lawns, trails and a pond.
ui.ko: 부산 부산진구에 있는 큰 도심 공원이다. 옛 미군 기지 터를 공원으로 바꾸었고 잔디 광장과 산책로, 연못이 있다.
ui.en: A large urban park in Busanjin-gu, Busan. It was converted from a former US military camp site and has lawns, trails and a pond.

ui.key: |A lava tube in Gujwa, Jeju, part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is known as a large lava cave, and only a section is open to visitors.
ui.ko: 제주 구좌읍에 있는 용암동굴로 유네스코 세계유산에 속한다. 세계적으로 규모가 큰 용암 동굴로 알려져 있고 일부 구간만 개방한다.
ui.en: A lava tube in Gujwa, Jeju, part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is known as a large lava cave, and only a section is open to visitors.

ui.key: |A leading performing arts venue near Gwanghwamun Square in Seoul. Its grand theater stages concerts, dance and plays.
ui.ko: 광화문광장 가까이에 있는 서울의 대표적인 공연장이다. 대극장에서 음악, 무용, 연극 등 여러 공연이 열린다.
ui.en: A leading performing arts venue near Gwanghwamun Square in Seoul. Its grand theater stages concerts, dance and plays.

ui.key: |A limestone cave in Danyang, North Chungcheong, designated a natural monument. It has well-developed stalactites and stalagmites along a maintained walkway.
ui.ko: 충북 단양에 있는 석회암 동굴로 천연기념물이다. 종유석과 석순이 발달해 있고 관람로가 정비되어 있다.
ui.en: A limestone cave in Danyang, North Chungcheong, designated a natural monument. It has well-developed stalactites and stalagmites along a maintained walkway.

ui.key: |A limestone cave in the Daei-ri cave area of Samcheok, designated as a natural monument. Its large chambers hold stalactites and an underground waterfall.
ui.ko: 강원 삼척 대이리 동굴지대에 있는 석회 동굴이다. 천연기념물로 지정되었고 넓은 동굴 안에 종유석과 폭포가 있다.
ui.en: A limestone cave in the Daei-ri cave area of Samcheok, designated as a natural monument. Its large chambers hold stalactites and an underground waterfall.

ui.key: |A linear park on the former Gyeongui railway line through Mapo and Yongsan. Walkers can stroll between Yeonnam-dong and Gongdeok past cafes and restaurants.
ui.ko: 옛 경의선 철길 자리에 조성한 마포·용산 일대의 선형 공원이다. 연남동과 공덕 사이를 산책하며 카페와 식당을 만날 수 있다.
ui.en: A linear park on the former Gyeongui railway line through Mapo and Yongsan. Walkers can stroll between Yeonnam-dong and Gongdeok past cafes and restaurants.

ui.key: |A lively district near Hongik University in Mapo-gu. Street performances, cafes, clubs and small shops give it a youthful feel.
ui.ko: 홍익대학교 앞 마포구의 번화가다. 거리 공연과 카페, 클럽, 작은 가게가 모여 젊은 분위기가 강하다.
ui.en: A lively district near Hongik University in Mapo-gu. Street performances, cafes, clubs and small shops give it a youthful feel.

ui.key: |A lone sea stack rising off the coast of Seogwipo. Volcanic cliffs and a coastal walking trail surround it.
ui.ko: 서귀포 앞바다에 홀로 솟은 바위 기둥이다. 화산 활동으로 생긴 해안 절벽 풍경과 산책로가 이어진다.
ui.en: A lone sea stack rising off the coast of Seogwipo. Volcanic cliffs and a coastal walking trail surround it.

ui.key: |A long cable-stayed bridge on the West Coast Expressway between Pyeongtaek in Gyeonggi and Dangjin in South Chungcheong. It spans Asan Bay.
ui.ko: 경기 평택과 충남 당진 사이 서해안고속도로의 다리다. 아산만 바다를 가로지르는 긴 사장교다.
ui.en: A long cable-stayed bridge on the West Coast Expressway between Pyeongtaek in Gyeonggi and Dangjin in South Chungcheong. It spans Asan Bay.

ui.key: |A long commercial complex between Jongno and Euljiro in Seoul, home to electronics and machinery shops. Stores selling parts and tools fill the building and nearby alleys.
ui.ko: 서울 종로와 을지로 사이에 길게 이어진 전자·기계 상가 건물이다. 부품과 공구를 파는 가게가 모여 있고 주변 골목이 이어진다.
ui.en: A long commercial complex between Jongno and Euljiro in Seoul, home to electronics and machinery shops. Stores selling parts and tools fill the building and nearby alleys.

ui.key: |A long row of old trees along the Gwanbang Stream embankment in Damyang. The embankment is said to have been built in the Joseon era to control floods.
ui.ko: 담양 관방천 둑을 따라 오래된 나무가 늘어선 숲이다. 조선 시대에 홍수를 막으려 쌓은 제방에 심은 것으로 전해진다.
ui.en: A long row of old trees along the Gwanbang Stream embankment in Damyang. The embankment is said to have been built in the Joseon era to control floods.

ui.key: |A long wooden footbridge across the Nakdong River in Andong. A famous love letter story inspired it, and at night it is lit up with a fountain.
ui.ko: 경북 안동 낙동강에 놓인 긴 나무 다리다. 이응태 부인의 편지에서 유래한 이야기가 있고 밤에는 조명과 분수가 켜진다.
ui.en: A long wooden footbridge across the Nakdong River in Andong. A famous love letter story inspired it, and at night it is lit up with a fountain.

ui.key: |A loop trail around Ansan in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul. Wooden decks and forest paths offer views of the city and Bukhansan.
ui.ko: 서울 서대문구 안산을 둘러 이어지는 순환 산책길이다. 나무 데크와 숲길을 따라 걸으며 도심과 북한산을 바라볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A loop trail around Ansan in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul. Wooden decks and forest paths offer views of the city and Bukhansan.

ui.key: |A low mountain beside the Han River in Gwangjin-gu. It holds the remains of Goguryeo fortresses and views of the river and eastern Seoul.
ui.ko: 광진구 한강 변에 있는 낮은 산이다. 고구려 보루 유적이 있으며 정상에서 한강과 서울 동쪽 풍경이 보인다.
ui.en: A low mountain beside the Han River in Gwangjin-gu. It holds the remains of Goguryeo fortresses and views of the river and eastern Seoul.

ui.key: |A low mountain in Seocho-gu, Seoul. Trails and a spring make it a light hike for locals, and the Seoul Arts Center lies nearby.
ui.ko: 서울 서초구에 있는 낮은 산이다. 산책로와 약수터가 있어 주민들이 가볍게 오르며 예술의전당과 가깝다.
ui.en: A low mountain in Seocho-gu, Seoul. Trails and a spring make it a light hike for locals, and the Seoul Arts Center lies nearby.

ui.key: |A low mountain rising near the Geum River in Sejong. The summit gives views of the river and the surrounding city.
ui.ko: 세종시 금강 가까이에 솟은 낮은 산이다. 정상에서 강과 주변 도시 풍경을 내려다볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A low mountain rising near the Geum River in Sejong. The summit gives views of the river and the surrounding city.

ui.key: |A low volcanic cone on Jeju's southwest shore with a loop trail. Views reach Gapado, Marado and the offshore islets.
ui.ko: 제주 서남쪽 바닷가에 있는 낮은 오름으로 둘레길이 이어진다. 가파도와 마라도, 형제섬이 보이는 전망이 좋다.
ui.en: A low volcanic cone on Jeju's southwest shore with a loop trail. Views reach Gapado, Marado and the offshore islets.

ui.key: |A low, flat island off Moseulpo in Jeju. In spring green barley fields cover it, and the whole island can be circled on foot.
ui.ko: 제주 모슬포 앞바다에 있는 낮고 평평한 섬이다. 봄에는 청보리밭이 펼쳐지며 걸어서 한 바퀴 돌아볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A low, flat island off Moseulpo in Jeju. In spring green barley fields cover it, and the whole island can be circled on foot.

ui.key: |A main peak of the Yeongnam Alps on the border of Ulsan and Yangsan. It is widely known for its silver grass plains in autumn.
ui.ko: 울산과 경남 양산 경계에 솟은 영남알프스의 대표 봉우리다. 가을 억새 평원으로 널리 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A main peak of the Yeongnam Alps on the border of Ulsan and Yangsan. It is widely known for its silver grass plains in autumn.

ui.key: |A major beach and resort district on the east side of Busan. It has a long sandy shore backed by high-rise buildings and is busy in summer.
ui.ko: 부산 동쪽에 있는 대표적인 해수욕장과 번화가다. 긴 모래사장과 바닷가 고층 건물이 인상적이며 여름에 사람이 많이 찾는다.
ui.en: A major beach and resort district on the east side of Busan. It has a long sandy shore backed by high-rise buildings and is busy in summer.

ui.key: |A major category with the same name already exists.
ui.en: A major category with the same name already exists.

ui.key: |A major city on China’s east coast and a center of commerce and finance. The Bund and the skyscrapers of Pudong define its skyline.
ui.ko: 중국 동부의 대도시로 상업과 금융의 중심이다. 와이탄과 푸둥의 고층 빌딩 야경이 대표 풍경이다.
ui.en: A major city on China’s east coast and a center of commerce and finance. The Bund and the skyscrapers of Pudong define its skyline.

ui.key: |A major fish market in Jung-gu, Busan. Live fish and seafood are sold, and you can eat raw fish on the spot.
ui.ko: 부산 중구에 있는 대표 수산시장이다. 살아 있는 생선과 해산물을 팔고 그 자리에서 회를 먹을 수 있다.
ui.en: A major fish market in Jung-gu, Busan. Live fish and seafood are sold, and you can eat raw fish on the spot.

ui.key: |A major fish market on the Han River in Dongjak-gu, Seoul. Visitors can buy fresh fish and seafood and have it prepared at nearby restaurants.
ui.ko: 서울 동작구 한강변에 있는 대표적인 수산시장이다. 신선한 생선과 해산물을 사서 식당에서 바로 먹을 수 있다.
ui.en: A major fish market on the Han River in Dongjak-gu, Seoul. Visitors can buy fresh fish and seafood and have it prepared at nearby restaurants.

ui.key: |A major road running through eastern Daegu. It connects the eastern city area around Dongdaegu Station.
ui.ko: 대구 동구를 지나는 큰 도로다. 대구 동쪽 도심과 동대구역 일대를 이어 주는 길이다.
ui.en: A major road running through eastern Daegu. It connects the eastern city area around Dongdaegu Station.

ui.key: |A major temple on the northern slope of Hallasan in Jeju City. It was badly damaged during the Jeju 4.3 events and later rebuilt, and it sits quietly among the trees.
ui.ko: 제주시 한라산 북쪽 자락에 있는 제주의 대표 사찰이다. 4·3 사건 때 큰 피해를 입었으나 다시 세워졌으며 숲으로 둘러싸여 조용하다.
ui.en: A major temple on the northern slope of Hallasan in Jeju City. It was badly damaged during the Jeju 4.3 events and later rebuilt, and it sits quietly among the trees.

ui.key: |A major traditional market in Jung-gu, Busan. It grew from a refugee gathering after the Korean War and is filled with clothing, sundries and food stalls.
ui.ko: 부산 중구에 있는 대표적인 전통시장이다. 한국전쟁 이후 피란민이 모여 시작되었고 의류와 잡화, 먹거리 가게가 가득하다.
ui.en: A major traditional market in Jung-gu, Busan. It grew from a refugee gathering after the Korean War and is filled with clothing, sundries and food stalls.

ui.key: |A major west coast beach in Boryeong, South Chungcheong. It has a wide sandy shore and shallow water, and hosts a mud festival in summer.
ui.ko: 충남 보령에 있는 서해안의 대표적인 해수욕장이다. 넓은 백사장과 얕은 바다가 이어지고 여름에는 머드 축제가 열린다.
ui.en: A major west coast beach in Boryeong, South Chungcheong. It has a wide sandy shore and shallow water, and hosts a mud festival in summer.

ui.key: |A man-made island in the middle of the Han River beneath Hangang Bridge. A performance venue and park offer views of Seoul from the water.
ui.ko: 한강 가운데 한강대교 아래에 있는 인공 섬이다. 공연장과 공원이 있어 강 위에서 서울 풍경을 즐길 수 있다.
ui.en: A man-made island in the middle of the Han River beneath Hangang Bridge. A performance venue and park offer views of Seoul from the water.

ui.key: |A market by the Seomjin River in Hwagae, Hadong, once a meeting point for people from two provinces. Today it sells local specialties and snacks.
ui.ko: 하동 화개면 섬진강 가에 있는 장터로 경남과 전남 사람들이 오가던 곳이다. 지금은 지역 특산물과 먹거리를 파는 관광지다.
ui.en: A market by the Seomjin River in Hwagae, Hadong, once a meeting point for people from two provinces. Today it sells local specialties and snacks.

ui.key: |A modern city in southern China just across from Hong Kong. It grew rapidly after economic reforms and is known as a technology hub.
ui.ko: 중국 남부 홍콩 맞은편에 있는 현대 도시다. 개혁 개방과 함께 빠르게 성장했고 기술 산업의 중심으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A modern city in southern China just across from Hong Kong. It grew rapidly after economic reforms and is known as a technology hub.

ui.key: |A mountain across Boeun in North Chungcheong and Sangju in North Gyeongsang, protected as a national park. Beopjusa temple and the rocky peak Munjangdae are well known.
ui.ko: 충북 보은과 경북 상주에 걸친 산으로 국립공원이다. 법주사와 문장대 등 바위 봉우리가 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain across Boeun in North Chungcheong and Sangju in North Gyeongsang, protected as a national park. Beopjusa temple and the rocky peak Munjangdae are well known.

ui.key: |A mountain across Gongju and Daejeon, protected as a national park. Its ridge resembles a rooster comb and a dragon, and the temples Gapsa and Donghaksa lie on it.
ui.ko: 충남 공주와 대전에 걸친 산으로 국립공원이다. 닭 볏과 용을 닮은 능선이라 이름 붙었고 갑사와 동학사가 있다.
ui.en: A mountain across Gongju and Daejeon, protected as a national park. Its ridge resembles a rooster comb and a dragon, and the temples Gapsa and Donghaksa lie on it.

ui.key: |A mountain across Hapcheon in South Gyeongsang and Seongju in North Gyeongsang, protected as a national park. It has rocky peaks and valleys, with Haeinsa temple on its slope.
ui.ko: 경남 합천과 경북 성주에 걸친 산으로 국립공원이다. 기암 봉우리와 계곡이 있고 해인사가 산자락에 있다.
ui.en: A mountain across Hapcheon in South Gyeongsang and Seongju in North Gyeongsang, protected as a national park. It has rocky peaks and valleys, with Haeinsa temple on its slope.

ui.key: |A mountain across Jecheon, Chungju and Danyang in North Chungcheong, protected as a national park. Its towering peak and views over Chungju Lake are known.
ui.ko: 충북 제천과 충주, 단양에 걸친 산으로 국립공원이다. 우뚝한 영봉과 충주호를 내려다보는 경치가 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain across Jecheon, Chungju and Danyang in North Chungcheong, protected as a national park. Its towering peak and views over Chungju Lake are known.

ui.key: |A mountain across Jeongeup in North Jeolla and Sunchang in South Jeolla, protected as a national park. It is especially famous for autumn foliage and has Naejangsa temple.
ui.ko: 전북 정읍과 전남 순창에 걸친 산으로 국립공원이다. 가을 단풍이 특히 유명하고 내장사가 있다.
ui.en: A mountain across Jeongeup in North Jeolla and Sunchang in South Jeolla, protected as a national park. It is especially famous for autumn foliage and has Naejangsa temple.

ui.key: |A mountain across Muju and Jangsu in North Jeolla and Geochang and Hamyang in South Gyeongsang, protected as a national park. It is known for snowy winter scenery and a ski resort.
ui.ko: 전북 무주·장수와 경남 거창·함양에 걸친 산으로 국립공원이다. 겨울 설경과 스키장이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain across Muju and Jangsu in North Jeolla and Geochang and Hamyang in South Gyeongsang, protected as a national park. It is known for snowy winter scenery and a ski resort.

ui.key: |A mountain across Pyeongchang, Hongcheon and Gangneung in Gangwon, protected as a national park. It has five peaks, deep forests and valley trails.
ui.ko: 강원 평창·홍천·강릉에 걸친 산으로 국립공원이다. 다섯 봉우리와 깊은 숲, 계곡을 따라 걷는 길이 있다.
ui.en: A mountain across Pyeongchang, Hongcheon and Gangneung in Gangwon, protected as a national park. It has five peaks, deep forests and valley trails.

ui.key: |A mountain across South Jeolla, North Jeolla and South Gyeongsang, and Korea’s first national park. Cheonwangbong, Nogodan, wide valleys and temples are well known.
ui.ko: 전남·전북·경남에 걸친 산으로 한국 최초의 국립공원이다. 천왕봉과 노고단, 넓은 계곡과 사찰이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain across South Jeolla, North Jeolla and South Gyeongsang, and Korea’s first national park. Cheonwangbong, Nogodan, wide valleys and temples are well known.

ui.key: |A mountain between Dong-gu in Daejeon and Okcheon in North Chungcheong. Ridge trails overlook the Daejeon cityscape and Daecheongho Lake.
ui.ko: 대전 동구와 충북 옥천 사이에 있는 산이다. 능선을 따라 걸으며 대전 시내와 대청호를 내려다볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A mountain between Dong-gu in Daejeon and Okcheon in North Chungcheong. Ridge trails overlook the Daejeon cityscape and Daecheongho Lake.

ui.key: |A mountain between Gumi and Gimcheon in North Gyeongsang, designated a provincial park. Geumosanseong Fortress, Daehye Falls and a cable car are its main features.
ui.ko: 경북 구미와 김천 사이에 있는 산으로 도립공원이다. 정상 부근의 금오산성과 대혜폭포, 케이블카가 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain between Gumi and Gimcheon in North Gyeongsang, designated a provincial park. Geumosanseong Fortress, Daehye Falls and a cable car are its main features.

ui.key: |A mountain between Jeonju and Gimje in North Jeolla. Geumsansa Temple lies on it, and the summit overlooks the Honam plain.
ui.ko: 전북 전주와 김제 사이에 있는 산이다. 금산사가 자리해 있고 정상에서 호남평야가 내려다보인다.
ui.en: A mountain between Jeonju and Gimje in North Jeolla. Geumsansa Temple lies on it, and the summit overlooks the Honam plain.

ui.key: |A mountain between Paju and Yangju in Gyeonggi. A historic stele stands near its summit, and a suspension bridge and views are well known.
ui.ko: 경기 파주와 양주 사이에 있는 산이다. 정상 부근에 감악산 비가 있고 출렁다리와 전망이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain between Paju and Yangju in Gyeonggi. A historic stele stands near its summit, and a suspension bridge and views are well known.

ui.key: |A mountain fortress on Sangdangsan in Cheongju, North Chungcheong. A trail along its walls looks over the city.
ui.ko: 충북 청주 상당산에 있는 산성이다. 성곽을 따라 걷는 길에서 청주 시내가 내려다보인다.
ui.en: A mountain fortress on Sangdangsan in Cheongju, North Chungcheong. A trail along its walls looks over the city.

ui.key: |A mountain fortress spanning Gwangju, Seongnam and Hanam in Gyeonggi, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It served as a refuge for Joseon kings, and a wall trail runs along it.
ui.ko: 경기 광주와 성남, 하남에 걸친 산성으로 유네스코 세계유산이다. 조선 시대에 임금이 피신했던 곳으로 성곽 길이 이어진다.
ui.en: A mountain fortress spanning Gwangju, Seongnam and Hanam in Gyeonggi, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It served as a refuge for Joseon kings, and a wall trail runs along it.

ui.key: |A mountain in Changnyeong, South Gyeongsang, with Hwawangsanseong Fortress at the summit. It is known for its autumn silver grass plain and a grass-burning event at the first full moon.
ui.ko: 경남 창녕에 있는 산으로 정상에 화왕산성이 있다. 가을 억새 평원과 정월대보름 억새태우기 행사로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Changnyeong, South Gyeongsang, with Hwawangsanseong Fortress at the summit. It is known for its autumn silver grass plain and a grass-burning event at the first full moon.

ui.key: |A mountain in Cheongsong, North Gyeongsang, protected as a national park. It is known for screen-like rock walls, waterfalls and valley trails.
ui.ko: 경북 청송에 있는 산으로 국립공원이다. 병풍 같은 암벽과 폭포, 계곡 길이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Cheongsong, North Gyeongsang, protected as a national park. It is known for screen-like rock walls, waterfalls and valley trails.

ui.key: |A mountain in Daedeok-gu, Daejeon. It is known for a barefoot walking trail of red clay and for the remains of a mountain fortress.
ui.ko: 대전 대덕구에 있는 산이다. 황톳길 맨발 걷기 코스로 알려져 있으며 산성 터도 남아 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Daedeok-gu, Daejeon. It is known for a barefoot walking trail of red clay and for the remains of a mountain fortress.

ui.key: |A mountain in Dalseong County, Daegu. Azaleas bloom in masses near the summit in spring, and a field of large boulders is a known feature.
ui.ko: 대구 달성군에 있는 산이다. 봄철 정상 부근에 진달래가 군락을 이루고 큰 바위 지대인 돌무더기 길이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Dalseong County, Daegu. Azaleas bloom in masses near the summit in spring, and a field of large boulders is a known feature.

ui.key: |A mountain in Danyang, North Chungcheong, named for its silk-embroidery-like autumn scenery. It is close to Chungju Lake, so lake views are part of the hike.
ui.ko: 충북 단양에 있는 산으로 이름처럼 비단에 수놓은 듯한 가을 풍경으로 알려져 있다. 충주호와 가까워 호수 전망도 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Danyang, North Chungcheong, named for its silk-embroidery-like autumn scenery. It is close to Chungju Lake, so lake views are part of the hike.

ui.key: |A mountain in Dobong-gu, Seoul, within Bukhansan National Park. It is known for rocky peaks such as Jaunbong and Seonin.
ui.ko: 서울 북쪽 도봉구에 있는 산으로 북한산 국립공원에 속한다. 자운봉과 선인봉 같은 바위 봉우리가 이어진다.
ui.en: A mountain in Dobong-gu, Seoul, within Bukhansan National Park. It is known for rocky peaks such as Jaunbong and Seonin.

ui.key: |A mountain in Dongducheon, Gyeonggi, close to the capital area and popular for day hikes. Jajaeam Hermitage, its falls and the autumn foliage are well known.
ui.ko: 경기 동두천에 있는 산으로 수도권에서 가까워 당일 산행지로 인기다. 자재암과 폭포, 가을 단풍이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Dongducheon, Gyeonggi, close to the capital area and popular for day hikes. Jajaeam Hermitage, its falls and the autumn foliage are well known.

ui.key: |A mountain in Gapyeong, Gyeonggi, with a natural recreation forest. Gentle forest trails suit family hikes, and it is known for paragliding and riverside drives.
ui.ko: 경기 가평에 있는 산으로 자연휴양림이 있다. 숲길이 완만해 가족 산행과 패러글라이딩, 강변 드라이브로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Gapyeong, Gyeonggi, with a natural recreation forest. Gentle forest trails suit family hikes, and it is known for paragliding and riverside drives.

ui.key: |A mountain in Goheung, South Jeolla, with eight peaks lined along the sea. The ridge gives wide views of the surrounding islands.
ui.ko: 전남 고흥에 있는 산으로 여덟 개의 봉우리가 바다를 따라 이어진다. 능선에서 다도해와 주변 섬이 한눈에 보인다.
ui.en: A mountain in Goheung, South Jeolla, with eight peaks lined along the sea. The ridge gives wide views of the surrounding islands.

ui.key: |A mountain in Haenam, South Jeolla, that shelters Daeheungsa Temple. From its ridge you can see the southern sea and islands, and it is a well-known hike near the peninsula's southern tip.
ui.ko: 전남 해남에 있는 산으로 대흥사를 품고 있다. 능선에서 남해 바다와 섬을 내려다볼 수 있고 한반도 남쪽 끝 산행지로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Haenam, South Jeolla, that shelters Daeheungsa Temple. From its ridge you can see the southern sea and islands, and it is a well-known hike near the peninsula's southern tip.

ui.key: |A mountain in Hapcheon known for spring royal azaleas and autumn silvergrass. Hikers walk its ridges and come for sunrise views.
ui.ko: 합천에 있는 산으로 봄 철쭉 군락과 가을 억새로 알려져 있다. 능선을 따라 걷는 산행과 일출 감상지로 찾는다.
ui.en: A mountain in Hapcheon known for spring royal azaleas and autumn silvergrass. Hikers walk its ridges and come for sunrise views.

ui.key: |A mountain in Inje, Gangwon, with deep, well-preserved valleys and forests. It is known for a recreation forest, autumn foliage and summer valley swimming.
ui.ko: 강원 인제에 있는 산으로 깊은 계곡과 숲이 잘 보존되어 있다. 자연휴양림과 가을 단풍, 여름 계곡 물놀이로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Inje, Gangwon, with deep, well-preserved valleys and forests. It is known for a recreation forest, autumn foliage and summer valley swimming.

ui.key: |A mountain in Jangsu, North Jeolla, lying between Deogyusan and Jirisan. Its silver grass ridge and valleys make it a favored autumn hiking spot.
ui.ko: 전북 장수에 있는 산으로 덕유산과 지리산 사이에 있다. 억새 능선과 계곡이 알려져 있고 가을 산행지로 찾는다.
ui.en: A mountain in Jangsu, North Jeolla, lying between Deogyusan and Jirisan. Its silver grass ridge and valleys make it a favored autumn hiking spot.

ui.key: |A mountain in Jinan, North Jeolla, and a main peak on the Geumnam ridgeline. Its long ridge gives views of the surrounding ranges from the summit.
ui.ko: 전북 진안에 있는 산으로 금남정맥의 주요 봉우리다. 능선이 길고 정상에서 주변 산줄기가 한눈에 보인다.
ui.en: A mountain in Jinan, North Jeolla, and a main peak on the Geumnam ridgeline. Its long ridge gives views of the surrounding ranges from the summit.

ui.key: |A mountain in Jinan, North Jeolla, whose two peaks rise like a horse’s ears. The clusters of stone towers at Tapsa temple are also well known.
ui.ko: 전북 진안에 있는 산으로 두 봉우리가 말의 귀처럼 솟았다. 탑사의 돌탑 무리가 함께 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Jinan, North Jeolla, whose two peaks rise like a horse’s ears. The clusters of stone towers at Tapsa temple are also well known.

ui.key: |A mountain in Nam-gu, Daegu, with many trails used by locals. Its lookout offers views over the city.
ui.ko: 대구 남구에 있는 산으로 시민들이 즐겨 찾는 등산로가 많다. 전망대에서 대구 시내를 내려다볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Nam-gu, Daegu, with many trails used by locals. Its lookout offers views over the city.

ui.key: |A mountain in Sejong that can be climbed close to the city. Trails run along its ridge and are popular with local walkers.
ui.ko: 세종시에 있는 산으로 도심 가까이에서 오를 수 있다. 능선을 따라 걷는 산책로가 이어져 주민들이 즐겨 찾는다.
ui.en: A mountain in Sejong that can be climbed close to the city. Trails run along its ridge and are popular with local walkers.

ui.key: |A mountain in Seo-gu, Daejeon, with a natural recreation forest. A metasequoia forest path and wooden observation tower are well known.
ui.ko: 대전 서구에 있는 산으로 자연휴양림이 있다. 메타세쿼이아 숲길과 나무 전망대가 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Seo-gu, Daejeon, with a natural recreation forest. A metasequoia forest path and wooden observation tower are well known.

ui.key: |A mountain in Sunchang designated a county park for its valleys and autumn foliage. A suspension bridge and waterfalls lie along the popular trail.
ui.ko: 순창에 있는 산으로 계곡과 단풍이 좋아 군립공원으로 지정되어 있다. 현수교와 폭포를 지나는 산책로가 인기다.
ui.en: A mountain in Sunchang designated a county park for its valleys and autumn foliage. A suspension bridge and waterfalls lie along the popular trail.

ui.key: |A mountain in Suncheon, South Jeolla, with Songgwangsa Temple on one side and Seonamsa Temple on the other. A forest path connects the two temples.
ui.ko: 전남 순천에 있는 산으로 동쪽에 송광사, 서쪽에 선암사가 있다. 두 절을 잇는 숲길이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Suncheon, South Jeolla, with Songgwangsa Temple on one side and Seonamsa Temple on the other. A forest path connects the two temples.

ui.key: |A mountain in Wonju, Gangwon, protected as a national park. It is known for steep ridges, Guryongsa temple and autumn colors.
ui.ko: 강원 원주에 있는 산으로 국립공원이다. 가파른 능선과 구룡사, 가을 단풍이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Wonju, Gangwon, protected as a national park. It is known for steep ridges, Guryongsa temple and autumn colors.

ui.key: |A mountain in Yangpyeong, Gyeonggi, home to Yongmunsa Temple. Its ancient ginkgo tree draws many visitors in autumn.
ui.ko: 경기 양평에 있는 산으로 용문사가 자리한다. 용문사 은행나무는 매우 오래된 노거수로 가을 단풍철에 많이 찾는다.
ui.en: A mountain in Yangpyeong, Gyeonggi, home to Yongmunsa Temple. Its ancient ginkgo tree draws many visitors in autumn.

ui.key: |A mountain in Yangsan, South Gyeongsang, tied to stories of the monk Wonhyo. It is known for a wetland and silver grass fields near the top and for its ridge hikes.
ui.ko: 경남 양산에 있는 산으로 원효대사의 일화가 전하는 곳이다. 정상 부근 습지와 억새밭, 능선 산행으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in Yangsan, South Gyeongsang, tied to stories of the monk Wonhyo. It is known for a wetland and silver grass fields near the top and for its ridge hikes.

ui.key: |A mountain in a national park spanning Danyang and Yeongju. It is known for royal azalea fields, gentle ridges and snowy winter scenery.
ui.ko: 충북 단양과 경북 영주에 걸친 국립공원의 산이다. 철쭉 군락과 완만한 능선, 겨울 눈 쌓인 풍경으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in a national park spanning Danyang and Yeongju. It is known for royal azalea fields, gentle ridges and snowy winter scenery.

ui.key: |A mountain in southern Ganghwado. Chamseongdan altar near the summit is linked to the legend of Dangun.
ui.ko: 강화도 남쪽에 있는 산이다. 정상 부근에 참성단이 있어 단군 전설과 관련된 곳으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in southern Ganghwado. Chamseongdan altar near the summit is linked to the legend of Dangun.

ui.key: |A mountain in the Yeongnam Alps on the border of Ulju County and Gyeongju. Silver grass meadows near the summit make it a favored autumn hike.
ui.ko: 울산 울주군과 경북 경주시에 걸친 영남알프스의 산이다. 정상 일대에 억새 평원이 펼쳐져 가을 산행지로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain in the Yeongnam Alps on the border of Ulju County and Gyeongju. Silver grass meadows near the summit make it a favored autumn hike.

ui.key: |A mountain north of Seoul protected as a national park. Granite peaks such as Baegundae and Insubong stand out, and many hiking trails cross it.
ui.ko: 서울 북쪽에 솟은 산으로 국립공원이다. 백운대와 인수봉의 화강암 봉우리가 대표적이고 등산로가 많다.
ui.en: A mountain north of Seoul protected as a national park. Granite peaks such as Baegundae and Insubong stand out, and many hiking trails cross it.

ui.key: |A mountain on the border of Nowon-gu in Seoul and Uijeongbu in Gyeonggi. Rock faces and valleys draw many hikers from northeastern Seoul.
ui.ko: 서울 노원구와 경기 의정부 경계에 있는 산이다. 암벽과 계곡이 있어 서울 북동부 시민이 많이 오른다.
ui.en: A mountain on the border of Nowon-gu in Seoul and Uijeongbu in Gyeonggi. Rock faces and valleys draw many hikers from northeastern Seoul.

ui.key: |A mountain on the south side of Seoul in Gwanak-gu. It is known for rocky peaks and the Yeonjudae hermitage, and attracts many hikers.
ui.ko: 서울 남쪽 관악구에 있는 산이다. 바위 봉우리와 연주대 암자가 알려져 있고 등산객이 많이 찾는다.
ui.en: A mountain on the south side of Seoul in Gwanak-gu. It is known for rocky peaks and the Yeonjudae hermitage, and attracts many hikers.

ui.key: |A mountain park in Cheongyang. It is known for winding ridges and Janggoksa temple, and for the rural scenery around it.
ui.ko: 충남 청양에 있는 산으로 도립공원이다. 굽이굽이 이어진 능선과 장곡사, 콩밭 같은 풍경으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain park in Cheongyang. It is known for winding ridges and Janggoksa temple, and for the rural scenery around it.

ui.key: |A mountain pass between Wanju and Jinan in North Jeolla. Its winding road over the hills is known as a drive.
ui.ko: 전북 완주와 진안 사이의 고개다. 산을 넘는 굽은 길이 이어져 드라이브 코스로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain pass between Wanju and Jinan in North Jeolla. Its winding road over the hills is known as a drive.

ui.key: |A mountain pass in the Yeongyang and Cheongsong area of North Gyeongsang. Its bends and deep mountains make a quiet drive.
ui.ko: 경북 영양과 청송 일대의 산악 고개다. 굽이진 길과 깊은 산세가 이어져 한적한 드라이브 코스다.
ui.en: A mountain pass in the Yeongyang and Cheongsong area of North Gyeongsang. Its bends and deep mountains make a quiet drive.

ui.key: |A mountain pass near Songnisan in Boeun, North Chungcheong. It has many hairpin bends, and an observatory overlooks Songnisan and nearby villages.
ui.ko: 충북 보은 속리산 가까이에 있는 고갯길이다. 굽은 길이 여러 번 이어지고 전망대에서 속리산과 마을이 내려다보인다.
ui.en: A mountain pass near Songnisan in Boeun, North Chungcheong. It has many hairpin bends, and an observatory overlooks Songnisan and nearby villages.

ui.key: |A mountain pass road in Hwacheon, Gangwon, crossing hilly country. It is known for winding curves, valleys and autumn foliage.
ui.ko: 강원 화천에 있는 고개 길로 화천 산골을 넘는다. 구불구불한 도로와 계곡, 가을 단풍이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain pass road in Hwacheon, Gangwon, crossing hilly country. It is known for winding curves, valleys and autumn foliage.

ui.key: |A mountain pass road on Seoraksan connecting Inje and Yangyang in Gangwon. It is known for its winding road, odd rock formations and autumn colors.
ui.ko: 강원 인제와 양양을 잇는 설악산의 고개 길이다. 구불구불한 도로와 기암괴석, 가을 단풍으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain pass road on Seoraksan connecting Inje and Yangyang in Gangwon. It is known for its winding road, odd rock formations and autumn colors.

ui.key: |A mountain rising above Sangju Beach in Namhae. Known for Borimam hermitage, it overlooks the southern sea between rocky peaks.
ui.ko: 경남 남해 상주 해변 위에 솟은 산이다. 남해 금산 보리암으로 알려져 있고 바위 봉우리 사이로 남해 바다가 내려다보인다.
ui.en: A mountain rising above Sangju Beach in Namhae. Known for Borimam hermitage, it overlooks the southern sea between rocky peaks.

ui.key: |A mountain rising by the coast in Jangheung, South Jeolla. It is known for odd rock formations and autumn silver grass, and its summit looks over the island-studded sea.
ui.ko: 전남 장흥 바닷가에 솟은 산이다. 기암괴석과 가을 억새로 알려져 있고 정상에서 다도해가 내려다보인다.
ui.en: A mountain rising by the coast in Jangheung, South Jeolla. It is known for odd rock formations and autumn silver grass, and its summit looks over the island-studded sea.

ui.key: |A mountain rising northeast of Daegu, protected as a provincial park. It is known for Buddhist sites such as Donghwasa and Gatbawi, and for hiking trails.
ui.ko: 대구 북동쪽에 솟은 산으로 도립공원이다. 동화사와 갓바위 같은 불교 유적과 등산로가 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain rising northeast of Daegu, protected as a provincial park. It is known for Buddhist sites such as Donghwasa and Gatbawi, and for hiking trails.

ui.key: |A mountain road around Cheonjabong in South Gyeongsang. The view opens up toward the summit and surrounding landscape.
ui.ko: 경남에 있는 천자봉 일대의 산 도로다. 산 정상에 가까워질수록 시야가 트여 주변 풍경이 펼쳐진다.
ui.en: A mountain road around Cheonjabong in South Gyeongsang. The view opens up toward the summit and surrounding landscape.

ui.key: |A mountain road leading up toward Nogodan in Jirisan. The winding route passes through forest and ridgelines with wide mountain views from the heights.
ui.ko: 지리산 노고단으로 오르는 산악 도로다. 구불구불한 길을 따라 숲과 능선이 이어지며 높은 곳에서 산의 풍경을 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A mountain road leading up toward Nogodan in Jirisan. The winding route passes through forest and ridgelines with wide mountain views from the heights.

ui.key: |A mountain south of Seoraksan in Gangwon, managed as a protected area. Its Gombaeryeong wildflower meadows are famous, and entry requires a reservation.
ui.ko: 강원 설악산 남쪽에 이어진 산으로 보호 구역으로 관리된다. 곰배령 야생화 군락이 알려져 있어 예약해야 들어갈 수 있다.
ui.en: A mountain south of Seoraksan in Gangwon, managed as a protected area. Its Gombaeryeong wildflower meadows are famous, and entry requires a reservation.

ui.key: |A mountain spanning Gapyeong and Pocheon, Gyeonggi, with jagged rocky peaks. Hyeondeungsa Temple lies on it, and it is known for its suspension bridge and autumn colors.
ui.ko: 경기 가평과 포천에 걸친 산으로 바위 봉우리가 뾰족하다. 산중에 현등사가 있고 구름다리와 가을 풍경이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain spanning Gapyeong and Pocheon, Gyeonggi, with jagged rocky peaks. Hyeondeungsa Temple lies on it, and it is known for its suspension bridge and autumn colors.

ui.key: |A mountain spanning Geumjeong-gu and Dongnae-gu in Busan. It holds Geumjeongsanseong Fortress and Beomeosa Temple, and is a hiking spot close to the city.
ui.ko: 부산 금정구와 동래구에 걸친 산이다. 한국에서 가장 큰 산성인 금정산성과 범어사가 있고 시내에서 가까운 산행지다.
ui.en: A mountain spanning Geumjeong-gu and Dongnae-gu in Busan. It holds Geumjeongsanseong Fortress and Beomeosa Temple, and is a hiking spot close to the city.

ui.key: |A mountain spanning Gwangju and Hwasun, protected as a national park. Columnar-jointed rock formations such as Seoseokdae and Ipseokdae are well known.
ui.ko: 광주와 화순에 걸친 산으로 국립공원이다. 주상절리 암벽인 서석대와 입석대가 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain spanning Gwangju and Hwasun, protected as a national park. Columnar-jointed rock formations such as Seoseokdae and Ipseokdae are well known.

ui.key: |A mountain spanning Hongseong and Boryeong in South Chungcheong. It is relatively tall for the west coast, with good views and a silver grass field near the top.
ui.ko: 충남 홍성과 보령에 걸친 산이다. 서해안 가까이에서는 높은 편이라 전망이 좋고 정상 부근 억새밭으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain spanning Hongseong and Boryeong in South Chungcheong. It is relatively tall for the west coast, with good views and a silver grass field near the top.

ui.key: |A mountain spanning Seocho-gu in Seoul and Seongnam and Gwacheon in Gyeonggi. Forest paths and valleys lead toward its peaks, attracting many hikers.
ui.ko: 서울 서초구와 경기 성남, 과천에 걸친 산이다. 정상 가까이 매봉이 있고 숲길과 계곡이 이어져 등산객이 많다.
ui.en: A mountain spanning Seocho-gu in Seoul and Seongnam and Gwacheon in Gyeonggi. Forest paths and valleys lead toward its peaks, attracting many hikers.

ui.key: |A mountain spanning Sokcho, Yangyang and Inje in Gangwon, a national park and UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. Rugged rock peaks, valleys and autumn foliage are the highlights.
ui.ko: 강원 속초·양양·인제에 걸친 산으로 국립공원이자 유네스코 생물권보전지역이다. 기암괴석과 계곡, 가을 단풍이 볼거리다.
ui.en: A mountain spanning Sokcho, Yangyang and Inje in Gangwon, a national park and UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. Rugged rock peaks, valleys and autumn foliage are the highlights.

ui.key: |A mountain spanning Yangsan and Ulsan, with Tongdosa Temple at its foot. It is known for its silver grass plateau and ridge views.
ui.ko: 경남 양산과 울산에 걸친 산으로 통도사가 아래에 자리한다. 정상 부근 억새 평원과 능선 풍경이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A mountain spanning Yangsan and Ulsan, with Tongdosa Temple at its foot. It is known for its silver grass plateau and ridge views.

ui.key: |A mountain straddling Gimcheon in North Gyeongsang and Yeongdong in North Chungcheong. Jikjisa Temple sits at its foot, and the gentle ridge is easy to climb.
ui.ko: 경북 김천과 충북 영동에 걸친 산이다. 산 아래에 직지사가 있고 능선이 완만해 오르기 좋다.
ui.en: A mountain straddling Gimcheon in North Gyeongsang and Yeongdong in North Chungcheong. Jikjisa Temple sits at its foot, and the gentle ridge is easy to climb.

ui.key: |A multipurpose dam on the Soyang River in Chuncheon. It is one of Korea's large rock-fill dams and overlooks Lake Soyang.
ui.ko: 강원 춘천 소양강을 막아 쌓은 다목적 댐이다. 국내에서 규모가 큰 사력댐 가운데 하나이며 위에서 소양호를 내려다볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A multipurpose dam on the Soyang River in Chuncheon. It is one of Korea's large rock-fill dams and overlooks Lake Soyang.

ui.key: |A municipal art museum in Buk-gu, Gwangju, close to the Biennale venue. It shows contemporary art and works by regional artists.
ui.ko: 광주 북구 비엔날레 가까이에 있는 시립 미술관이다. 현대 미술과 지역 작가의 작품을 전시한다.
ui.en: A municipal art museum in Buk-gu, Gwangju, close to the Biennale venue. It shows contemporary art and works by regional artists.

ui.key: |A municipal art museum next to Deoksugung Palace in central Seoul. It reuses the facade of the former Supreme Court building and hosts contemporary art exhibitions.
ui.ko: 서울 도심 덕수궁 옆에 있는 시립 미술관이다. 옛 대법원 건물의 정면을 살려 쓰고 있으며, 현대 미술 전시가 열린다.
ui.en: A municipal art museum next to Deoksugung Palace in central Seoul. It reuses the facade of the former Supreme Court building and hosts contemporary art exhibitions.

ui.key: |A mural village on a seaside hill in Tongyeong, South Gyeongsang. Paintings fill the alleys, and the harbor can be seen from above.
ui.ko: 경남 통영 바닷가 언덕에 있는 벽화 마을이다. 골목마다 그림이 있고 항구가 내려다보인다.
ui.en: A mural village on a seaside hill in Tongyeong, South Gyeongsang. Paintings fill the alleys, and the harbor can be seen from above.

ui.key: |A museum complex in Cheonan, South Chungcheong, covering the independence movement under Japanese rule and modern Korean history. Large exhibition halls stand in a broad open park.
ui.ko: 충남 천안에 있는 박물관 단지로 일제강점기 독립운동과 한국 근현대사를 다룬다. 넓은 야외 공간에 큰 전시관이 이어진다.
ui.en: A museum complex in Cheonan, South Chungcheong, covering the independence movement under Japanese rule and modern Korean history. Large exhibition halls stand in a broad open park.

ui.key: |A museum in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, next to the National Museum of Korea. Its exhibits introduce how the Korean alphabet was created and its history.
ui.ko: 서울 용산구 국립중앙박물관 옆에 있는 박물관이다. 한글의 만들어진 과정과 역사를 전시로 소개한다.
ui.en: A museum in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, next to the National Museum of Korea. Its exhibits introduce how the Korean alphabet was created and its history.

ui.key: |A museum near the port of Gunsan. It presents the modern history and everyday life of the city after the port opened.
ui.ko: 전북 군산 항구 근처에 있는 박물관이다. 일제강점기 개항 이후 군산의 근대 역사와 생활상을 소개한다.
ui.en: A museum near the port of Gunsan. It presents the modern history and everyday life of the city after the port opened.

ui.key: |A museum on printing culture in Cheongju. It exhibits materials about Jikji, which is known as the oldest extant book printed with movable metal type.
ui.ko: 충북 청주에 있는 인쇄 문화 박물관이다. 세계에서 가장 오래된 금속활자본으로 알려진 직지와 관련한 자료를 전시한다.
ui.en: A museum on printing culture in Cheongju. It exhibits materials about Jikji, which is known as the oldest extant book printed with movable metal type.

ui.key: |A national arboretum in Sejong City gathering plants from several climate zones. Visitors can tour its greenhouse and traditional Korean gardens.
ui.ko: 세종시에 있는 국립 수목원으로, 다양한 기후대의 식물을 한곳에 모았다. 온실과 한국 전통 정원 등을 둘러볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A national arboretum in Sejong City gathering plants from several climate zones. Visitors can tour its greenhouse and traditional Korean gardens.

ui.key: |A national cemetery in Buk-gu, Gwangju, for victims of the May 18 Democratic Uprising. It has a memorial tower, a place for paying respects and an exhibition hall.
ui.ko: 광주 북구에 있는 5·18 민주화운동 희생자들이 묻힌 국립묘지다. 기념탑과 참배 공간, 전시관이 있다.
ui.en: A national cemetery in Buk-gu, Gwangju, for victims of the May 18 Democratic Uprising. It has a memorial tower, a place for paying respects and an exhibition hall.

ui.key: |A national cemetery in Dongjak-gu, Seoul, where those who sacrificed for the country are laid to rest. The memorial tower and broad graves extend along the foot of Gwanaksan.
ui.ko: 서울 동작구에 있는 국립묘지로, 나라를 위해 희생한 분들이 잠들어 있다. 현충탑과 넓은 묘역이 관악산 자락에 이어진다.
ui.en: A national cemetery in Dongjak-gu, Seoul, where those who sacrificed for the country are laid to rest. The memorial tower and broad graves extend along the foot of Gwanaksan.

ui.key: |A national garden along the Taehwa River that runs through Ulsan. The broad bamboo grove and seasonal flower fields are the main sights.
ui.ko: 울산 도심을 가로지르는 태화강 변의 국가정원이다. 넓은 십리대숲과 계절마다 피는 꽃밭이 볼거리다.
ui.en: A national garden along the Taehwa River that runs through Ulsan. The broad bamboo grove and seasonal flower fields are the main sights.

ui.key: |A national library near the government buildings in Sejong City. The building resembles an open book and has a rooftop garden.
ui.ko: 세종시 정부청사 가까이에 있는 국립 도서관이다. 책을 펼친 모양을 닮은 건물과 옥상 정원이 특징이다.
ui.en: A national library near the government buildings in Sejong City. The building resembles an open book and has a rooftop garden.

ui.key: |A national park mountain in Yeongam. It is known for rocky peaks along the ridge and a suspension bridge.
ui.ko: 전남 영암에 있는 국립공원 산이다. 기암괴석이 솟은 능선과 구름다리가 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A national park mountain in Yeongam. It is known for rocky peaks along the ridge and a suspension bridge.

ui.key: |A national performing arts venue on the slope of Namsan. Several theaters, including Haeoreum Theater, present plays, opera and traditional performances.
ui.ko: 남산 자락에 있는 국가 공연장이다. 해오름극장 등 여러 극장에서 연극, 오페라, 전통 공연이 열린다.
ui.en: A national performing arts venue on the slope of Namsan. Several theaters, including Haeoreum Theater, present plays, opera and traditional performances.

ui.key: |A national university at the foot of Gwanaksan in Gwanak-gu, Seoul. Its large campus spreads along the mountain slope, and its gate is widely recognized.
ui.ko: 서울 관악구 관악산 아래에 있는 국립대학교다. 넓은 캠퍼스가 산자락을 따라 이어지고 정문 모양이 잘 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A national university at the foot of Gwanaksan in Gwanak-gu, Seoul. Its large campus spreads along the mountain slope, and its gate is widely recognized.

ui.key: |A natural lagoon by the sea in Sokcho. A walking path circles the lake and Seoraksan can be seen in the distance.
ui.ko: 강원 속초 바닷가에 있는 자연 석호다. 호수 둘레를 도는 산책로가 있고 설악산이 멀리 보인다.
ui.en: A natural lagoon by the sea in Sokcho. A walking path circles the lake and Seoraksan can be seen in the distance.

ui.key: |A natural rock gateway in Muju, North Jeolla. It is said to mark the old border between Silla and Baekje.
ui.ko: 전북 무주에 있는 통로 모양의 바위 문이다. 옛 신라와 백제의 경계로 전해지는 곳이다.
ui.en: A natural rock gateway in Muju, North Jeolla. It is said to mark the old border between Silla and Baekje.

ui.key: |A neighborhood in Nam-gu, Gwangju, with preserved early modern buildings. Western-style houses, missionary sites, cafes and small galleries share the streets.
ui.ko: 광주 남구에 있는 근대 건축이 남은 동네다. 서양식 건물과 선교사 유적, 작은 카페와 갤러리가 어우러진다.
ui.en: A neighborhood in Nam-gu, Gwangju, with preserved early modern buildings. Western-style houses, missionary sites, cafes and small galleries share the streets.

ui.key: |A neighborhood of narrow alleys and hanok houses near Jongno 3-ga. Many of the old houses have become cafes and restaurants.
ui.ko: 종로 3가 근처의 좁은 골목에 한옥이 모인 동네다. 한옥을 고쳐 만든 카페와 식당이 많다.
ui.en: A neighborhood of narrow alleys and hanok houses near Jongno 3-ga. Many of the old houses have become cafes and restaurants.

ui.key: |A neighborhood of traditional houses between Gyeongbokgung and Changdeokgung. Its alleys offer views of hanok roofs with the city beyond.
ui.ko: 경복궁과 창덕궁 사이에 한옥이 모여 있는 마을이다. 골목길을 따라 전통 가옥과 서울 도심 풍경을 함께 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A neighborhood of traditional houses between Gyeongbokgung and Changdeokgung. Its alleys offer views of hanok roofs with the city beyond.

ui.key: |A neighborhood traditional market in Mangwon-dong, Mapo-gu, Seoul. Food and household stores fill it, and the Han River and cozy alleys lie nearby.
ui.ko: 서울 마포구 망원동의 동네 전통시장이다. 먹거리와 생활용품 가게가 모여 있고 주변에 한강과 아기자기한 골목이 있다.
ui.en: A neighborhood traditional market in Mangwon-dong, Mapo-gu, Seoul. Food and household stores fill it, and the Han River and cozy alleys lie nearby.

ui.key: |A palace facing Seoul City Hall that served the Korean Empire as an imperial residence. Traditional halls stand beside a Western-style stone building.
ui.ko: 서울시청 앞에 있는 궁궐로 대한제국 시기에 황실이 머물렀다. 전통 건물과 서양식 석조전이 함께 있다.
ui.en: A palace facing Seoul City Hall that served the Korean Empire as an imperial residence. Traditional halls stand beside a Western-style stone building.

ui.key: |A park built for the 1988 Seoul Olympics. Sports venues, sculptures and wide lawns make it good for walks and rest.
ui.ko: 1988년 서울 올림픽을 기념해 조성한 공원이다. 체육 경기장과 조각 작품, 잔디밭이 있어 산책과 휴식에 좋다.
ui.en: A park built for the 1988 Seoul Olympics. Sports venues, sculptures and wide lawns make it good for walks and rest.

ui.key: |A park in Gwangjin-gu with children’s play areas and a small zoo. Wide lawns and a botanical garden make it suitable for family visits.
ui.ko: 광진구에 있는 공원으로 어린이를 위한 놀이 시설과 동물원이 있다. 넓은 잔디밭과 식물원도 있어 가족 나들이에 알맞다.
ui.en: A park in Gwangjin-gu with children’s play areas and a small zoo. Wide lawns and a botanical garden make it suitable for family visits.

ui.key: |A park in Jung District, Daejeon, themed around family names and genealogy. It has monuments about the origins of Korean clans and pleasant walking paths.
ui.ko: 대전 중구에 있는 공원으로, 성씨와 족보를 주제로 꾸민 곳이다. 여러 성씨의 뿌리를 알리는 조형물과 산책로가 있다.
ui.en: A park in Jung District, Daejeon, themed around family names and genealogy. It has monuments about the origins of Korean clans and pleasant walking paths.

ui.key: |A park in Jung-gu, Daegu, built on the site of the old Dalseong earthen fortress. It has a zoo and walking paths and serves as a city retreat.
ui.ko: 대구 중구에 있는 공원으로 옛 달성 토성 터에 조성되었다. 동물원과 산책로가 있고 도심 속 쉼터로 쓰인다.
ui.en: A park in Jung-gu, Daegu, built on the site of the old Dalseong earthen fortress. It has a zoo and walking paths and serves as a city retreat.

ui.key: |A park in Seo-gu, Gwangju, commemorating the May 18 Democratic Uprising. It occupies a former military site from that period.
ui.ko: 광주 서구에 있는 5·18 민주화운동을 기억하는 공원이다. 당시 군 시설이 있던 자리에 조성되었다.
ui.en: A park in Seo-gu, Gwangju, commemorating the May 18 Democratic Uprising. It occupies a former military site from that period.

ui.key: |A park in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, created for the 1993 Daejeon Expo. It features the Hanbit Tower and science facilities.
ui.ko: 대전 유성구에 있는 공원으로 1993년 대전 엑스포를 계기로 조성되었다. 한빛탑과 과학 시설이 있다.
ui.en: A park in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, created for the 1993 Daejeon Expo. It features the Hanbit Tower and science facilities.

ui.key: |A park on Naksan, the eastern hill of the old Seoul city wall. A walking path follows the wall and offers night views of the city.
ui.ko: 서울 한양도성 동쪽 낙산에 조성된 공원이다. 성곽길을 따라 걸으며 도심 야경을 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A park on Naksan, the eastern hill of the old Seoul city wall. A walking path follows the wall and offers night views of the city.

ui.key: |A park on a small island in the Han River. It reuses an old water treatment plant, blending ponds, plants and industrial structures.
ui.ko: 한강 가운데 작은 섬에 있는 공원이다. 옛 정수장 시설을 활용해 만들었으며 연못과 식물, 철제 구조물이 어우러진다.
ui.en: A park on a small island in the Han River. It reuses an old water treatment plant, blending ponds, plants and industrial structures.

ui.key: |A park road running along the Han River in Seoul. It offers views of the river and skyline for walking and driving.
ui.ko: 서울 한강 변을 따라 이어지는 공원길이다. 강과 도심 풍경을 보며 걷거나 달리기 좋은 길이다.
ui.en: A park road running along the Han River in Seoul. It offers views of the river and skyline for walking and driving.

ui.key: |A pass between Mungyeong in North Gyeongsang and Chungju in North Chungcheong. It is known as an ancient route with a pleasant forest trail.
ui.ko: 경북 문경과 충북 충주 사이의 고개다. 신라 시대부터 이어진 길로 알려져 있으며 숲길이 아름답다.
ui.en: A pass between Mungyeong in North Gyeongsang and Chungju in North Chungcheong. It is known as an ancient route with a pleasant forest trail.

ui.key: |A pass on the western side of Jirisan in Namwon, North Jeolla. You can drive up to see the ridgeline and a sea of clouds, with views toward Nogodan.
ui.ko: 전북 남원 지리산 서쪽에 있는 고개다. 차로 올라 지리산 능선과 운해를 볼 수 있고 노고단 방향 능선 경치가 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A pass on the western side of Jirisan in Namwon, North Jeolla. You can drive up to see the ridgeline and a sea of clouds, with views toward Nogodan.

ui.key: |A pass road in Hamyang, South Gyeongsang, with a strikingly winding shape. It is known for night photos of car light trails.
ui.ko: 경남 함양에 있는 고갯길로 굽이굽이 이어지는 모양이 눈에 띈다. 밤에 차량 불빛이 만드는 궤적 사진으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A pass road in Hamyang, South Gyeongsang, with a strikingly winding shape. It is known for night photos of car light trails.

ui.key: |A path along Hagui Stream, which flows through Anyang and Uiwang in Gyeonggi. Walking and cycling trails follow the water.
ui.ko: 경기 안양과 의왕을 흐르는 학의천 변의 길이다. 하천을 따라 산책로와 자전거길이 이어진다.
ui.en: A path along Hagui Stream, which flows through Anyang and Uiwang in Gyeonggi. Walking and cycling trails follow the water.

ui.key: |A path along Yangjaecheon stream through Seocho and Gangnam in Seoul. Walking and cycling trails follow the water.
ui.ko: 서울 서초와 강남을 흐르는 양재천 변의 길이다. 하천을 따라 산책로와 자전거길이 이어진다.
ui.en: A path along Yangjaecheon stream through Seocho and Gangnam in Seoul. Walking and cycling trails follow the water.

ui.key: |A pebble beach on the coast of Dong District, Ulsan. Waves rolling over the smooth round stones make a distinctive sound.
ui.ko: 울산 동구 바닷가에 있는 몽돌해변이다. 파도에 닳은 둥근 자갈이 밀려가며 내는 소리가 특징이다.
ui.en: A pebble beach on the coast of Dong District, Ulsan. Waves rolling over the smooth round stones make a distinctive sound.

ui.key: |A pedestrian-only bridge over the Geum River in Sejong City, with a distinctive ring-shaped design. Visitors can stroll above the river and enjoy the view.
ui.ko: 세종시에서 금강을 가로지르는 보행 전용 다리로, 둥근 고리 모양의 독특한 형태다. 강 위를 걸으며 경치를 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A pedestrian-only bridge over the Geum River in Sejong City, with a distinctive ring-shaped design. Visitors can stroll above the river and enjoy the view.

ui.key: |A pine tree near the entrance to Songnisan in Boeun, designated a natural monument. Legend says it lifted its branch for King Sejo of Joseon as he passed.
ui.ko: 보은 속리산 입구에 있는 소나무로 천연기념물이다. 조선 세조가 지나갈 때 가지를 들어 올렸다는 전설이 전해진다.
ui.en: A pine tree near the entrance to Songnisan in Boeun, designated a natural monument. Legend says it lifted its branch for King Sejo of Joseon as he passed.

ui.key: |A plan cannot be moved inside its own sub-routine.
ui.ko: 계획을 자기 하위 루틴 안으로 옮길 수 없습니다.
ui.en: A plan cannot be moved inside its own sub-routine.

ui.key: |A planted birch forest in Wondae-ri, Inje. Slender white trunks line a trail made for slow walks.
ui.ko: 인제 원대리에 조성된 자작나무 숲이다. 흰 줄기가 곧게 뻗은 숲길을 따라 천천히 걸을 수 있다.
ui.en: A planted birch forest in Wondae-ri, Inje. Slender white trunks line a trail made for slow walks.

ui.key: |A port and industrial city at the northern tip of Kyushu, Japan. The retro Mojiko district and Kokura Castle are nearby, not far from Fukuoka.
ui.ko: 일본 규슈 북쪽 끝의 항구 공업 도시다. 모지코 레트로 지구와 고쿠라성이 있고 후쿠오카와 가깝다.
ui.en: A port and industrial city at the northern tip of Kyushu, Japan. The retro Mojiko district and Kokura Castle are nearby, not far from Fukuoka.

ui.key: |A port city at the northern tip of Honshu, Japan. It is known for the Nebuta festival, apples and fresh seafood.
ui.ko: 일본 혼슈 최북단의 항구 도시다. 네부타 축제와 사과, 신선한 해산물로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A port city at the northern tip of Honshu, Japan. It is known for the Nebuta festival, apples and fresh seafood.

ui.key: |A port city in Hyogo, Japan, shaped by early foreign trade. It is known for the Kitano foreign residences, Kobe beef and harbor night views.
ui.ko: 일본 효고현의 항구 도시로 개항 이후 서양 문물이 들어온 곳이다. 이진칸 거리와 고베 비프, 항구 야경이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A port city in Hyogo, Japan, shaped by early foreign trade. It is known for the Kitano foreign residences, Kobe beef and harbor night views.

ui.key: |A port city in Liaoning, China, on the Yellow Sea coast. It has seaside squares and promenades and is known for fresh seafood.
ui.ko: 중국 랴오닝성의 항구 도시로 황해 연안에 있다. 해안 광장과 해변 산책로가 있고 신선한 해산물이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A port city in Liaoning, China, on the Yellow Sea coast. It has seaside squares and promenades and is known for fresh seafood.

ui.key: |A port city in Zhejiang, China, with a long history as a trading harbor. Historic sites such as Tianyi Pavilion library sit alongside a modern cityscape.
ui.ko: 중국 저장성에 있는 항구 도시다. 오래된 무역 항구로 천일각 장서루 같은 역사 유적과 현대적인 도시 풍경을 함께 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A port city in Zhejiang, China, with a long history as a trading harbor. Historic sites such as Tianyi Pavilion library sit alongside a modern cityscape.

ui.key: |A port city in southern Hokkaido, Japan. It is famous for the night view from Mount Hakodate, its morning market and hillside old Western-style buildings.
ui.ko: 일본 홋카이도 남쪽의 항구 도시다. 하코다테산의 야경과 아침 시장, 서양식 건물이 있는 언덕 마을이 유명하다.
ui.en: A port city in southern Hokkaido, Japan. It is famous for the night view from Mount Hakodate, its morning market and hillside old Western-style buildings.

ui.key: |A port city in western Kyushu, Japan, long a window to the outside world. It is known for its Peace Park, hillside night views and champon noodles.
ui.ko: 일본 규슈 서쪽의 항구 도시로 오랫동안 해외 교류의 창구였다. 평화 공원과 언덕 위 야경, 짬뽕으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A port city in western Kyushu, Japan, long a window to the outside world. It is known for its Peace Park, hillside night views and champon noodles.

ui.key: |A port city on Honshu’s Sea of Japan coast. It is known for rice and sake, with ferries to Sado Island.
ui.ko: 일본 혼슈 동해 쪽의 항구 도시다. 쌀과 사케로 알려져 있고 사도섬으로 가는 배편이 있다.
ui.en: A port city on Honshu’s Sea of Japan coast. It is known for rice and sake, with ferries to Sado Island.

ui.key: |A prefecture in northeastern Kanto, Japan, close to Tokyo. It is known for Kairakuen Garden in Mito and the nemophila flower fields of Hitachi Seaside Park.
ui.ko: 일본 간토 지방 북동쪽의 현으로 도쿄에서 가깝다. 미토의 가이라쿠엔 정원과 히타치 해변공원의 네모필라 꽃밭으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A prefecture in northeastern Kanto, Japan, close to Tokyo. It is known for Kairakuen Garden in Mito and the nemophila flower fields of Hitachi Seaside Park.

ui.key: |A prehistoric dolmen site in Gochang, North Jeolla, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Hundreds of dolmens are scattered along the foothills.
ui.ko: 전북 고창에 있는 선사시대 고인돌 유적으로 유네스코 세계유산이다. 수백 기의 고인돌이 산자락을 따라 분포한다.
ui.en: A prehistoric dolmen site in Gochang, North Jeolla, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Hundreds of dolmens are scattered along the foothills.

ui.key: |A preserved old station on the Gyeongchun Line in Nowon-gu. The old station building and train cars are used as exhibition spaces.
ui.ko: 경춘선의 옛 기차역을 보존한 곳으로 노원구에 있다. 옛 역사와 객차를 활용한 전시 공간이 있다.
ui.en: A preserved old station on the Gyeongchun Line in Nowon-gu. The old station building and train cars are used as exhibition spaces.

ui.key: |A private art museum in Hannam-dong, Yongsan-gu. It holds both traditional and contemporary art in buildings designed by well-known architects.
ui.ko: 서울 용산구 한남동에 있는 사립 미술관이다. 전통 미술과 현대 미술을 함께 소장하고 유명 건축가들이 지은 건물로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A private art museum in Hannam-dong, Yongsan-gu. It holds both traditional and contemporary art in buildings designed by well-known architects.

ui.key: |A private university in Anam-dong, Seongbuk-gu, Seoul. A stone main hall and a wide lawn stand at the heart of the campus.
ui.ko: 서울 성북구 안암동에 있는 사립대학교다. 돌로 지은 본관과 넓은 잔디 광장이 캠퍼스 중심에 있다.
ui.en: A private university in Anam-dong, Seongbuk-gu, Seoul. A stone main hall and a wide lawn stand at the heart of the campus.

ui.key: |A private university in Sinchon, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul. Its campus is known for old stone buildings and wooded paths.
ui.ko: 서울 서대문구 신촌에 있는 사립대학교다. 돌로 지은 오래된 건물과 숲길이 있는 캠퍼스로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A private university in Sinchon, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul. Its campus is known for old stone buildings and wooded paths.

ui.key: |A professional baseball park in Buk-gu, Gwangju. It is the home of the KIA Tigers and opened in 2014.
ui.ko: 광주 북구에 있는 프로야구 구장이다. KIA 타이거즈의 홈구장으로 2014년에 문을 열었다.
ui.en: A professional baseball park in Buk-gu, Gwangju. It is the home of the KIA Tigers and opened in 2014.

ui.key: |A professional baseball park in Jung-gu, Daejeon. It is the home of the Hanwha Eagles and opened as a new stadium in 2025.
ui.ko: 대전 중구에 있는 프로야구 구장이다. 한화 이글스의 홈구장으로 2025년에 새로 문을 열었다.
ui.en: A professional baseball park in Jung-gu, Daejeon. It is the home of the Hanwha Eagles and opened as a new stadium in 2025.

ui.key: |A professional baseball park in Suseong-gu, Daegu. It is the home of the Samsung Lions and opened in 2016.
ui.ko: 대구 수성구에 있는 프로야구 구장이다. 삼성 라이온즈의 홈구장으로 2016년에 문을 열었다.
ui.en: A professional baseball park in Suseong-gu, Daegu. It is the home of the Samsung Lions and opened in 2016.

ui.key: |A publishing district in Paju made up of publishers, printers, bookstores and galleries. It is a place to enjoy books alongside distinctive architecture.
ui.ko: 경기 파주에 조성된 출판 단지다. 출판사와 인쇄소, 서점과 갤러리가 모여 있어 책과 건축을 함께 즐길 수 있다.
ui.en: A publishing district in Paju made up of publishers, printers, bookstores and galleries. It is a place to enjoy books alongside distinctive architecture.

ui.key: |A rail bike ride along an old coastal railway in Samcheok. Riders pedal past sea and cliff scenery.
ui.ko: 강원 삼척 동해안 옛 철길을 따라 달리는 레일바이크다. 바다와 절벽 풍경을 보며 페달을 밟을 수 있다.
ui.en: A rail bike ride along an old coastal railway in Samcheok. Riders pedal past sea and cliff scenery.

ui.key: |A railway station in Gwangsan-gu, Gwangju. It is a major gateway served by high-speed trains and is close to the airport.
ui.ko: 광주 광산구에 있는 철도역이다. 고속철도가 서는 광주의 주요 관문으로 공항과 가까워 이동이 편하다.
ui.en: A railway station in Gwangsan-gu, Gwangju. It is a major gateway served by high-speed trains and is close to the airport.

ui.key: |A railway station in Jochiwon, Sejong, on the Gyeongbu Line. It serves as a northern gateway to the city.
ui.ko: 세종시 조치원읍에 있는 철도역이다. 경부선이 지나는 역으로 세종 북부의 관문 구실을 한다.
ui.en: A railway station in Jochiwon, Sejong, on the Gyeongbu Line. It serves as a northern gateway to the city.

ui.key: |A ranch on the Daegwallyeong highlands in Pyeongchang where visitors can feed sheep. Walking paths cross open meadows and ridgelines.
ui.ko: 평창 대관령 고원에 있는 목장으로 양에게 먹이를 주는 체험을 할 수 있다. 초원과 능선이 이어지는 산책로가 있다.
ui.en: A ranch on the Daegwallyeong highlands in Pyeongchang where visitors can feed sheep. Walking paths cross open meadows and ridgelines.

ui.key: |A remote island at the southwestern edge of Sinan, South Jeolla, known for skate fish and migratory birds. The scholar Jeong Yak-jeon is said to have lived here in exile, and the coastal scenery is worth seeing.
ui.ko: 전남 신안 서남쪽 끝에 있는 섬으로 홍어와 철새로 알려져 있다. 정약전이 유배 와서 지낸 곳으로 전하며 섬을 도는 해안 경치가 볼만하다.
ui.en: A remote island at the southwestern edge of Sinan, South Jeolla, known for skate fish and migratory birds. The scholar Jeong Yak-jeon is said to have lived here in exile, and the coastal scenery is worth seeing.

ui.key: |A reservoir in Hwasun known for mountain reflections on its water. Spring blossoms, morning mist and autumn leaves attract photographers.
ui.ko: 화순에 있는 저수지로 물가에 비친 산 풍경이 알려져 있다. 봄 벚꽃과 새벽 물안개, 가을 단풍이 사진 명소다.
ui.en: A reservoir in Hwasun known for mountain reflections on its water. Spring blossoms, morning mist and autumn leaves attract photographers.

ui.key: |A restored stream running through downtown Seoul. The walking path stretches east from near Gwanghwamun and passes under many bridges.
ui.ko: 서울 도심을 가로지르는 하천을 복원해 만든 산책로다. 광화문 근처에서 동쪽으로 길게 이어지며 다리 아래를 걸을 수 있다.
ui.en: A restored stream running through downtown Seoul. The walking path stretches east from near Gwanghwamun and passes under many bridges.

ui.key: |A river bend near Seonam Village in Yeongwol that curves into the shape of the Korean Peninsula. An overlook shows the winding Seogang River and surrounding forest.
ui.ko: 영월 선암마을 부근에 있는 지형으로 강이 휘돌아 한반도 모양을 이룬다. 전망대에서 굽이치는 서강과 숲이 내려다보인다.
ui.en: A river bend near Seonam Village in Yeongwol that curves into the shape of the Korean Peninsula. An overlook shows the winding Seogang River and surrounding forest.

ui.key: |A riverside park along the Han River in Gwangjin-gu. Bike paths, lawns and a pool make it popular for relaxing and exercise.
ui.ko: 광진구 한강 변에 있는 공원이다. 자전거길과 잔디밭, 수영장 같은 시설이 있어 휴식과 운동에 많이 찾는다.
ui.en: A riverside park along the Han River in Gwangjin-gu. Bike paths, lawns and a pool make it popular for relaxing and exercise.

ui.key: |A riverside park on Yeouido along the Han River. It has broad lawns and walking paths, and is known for spring cherry blossoms and fireworks events.
ui.ko: 한강 변 여의도에 있는 공원이다. 넓은 잔디밭과 산책로가 있고 봄에는 벚꽃, 가을에는 불꽃 축제로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A riverside park on Yeouido along the Han River. It has broad lawns and walking paths, and is known for spring cherry blossoms and fireworks events.

ui.key: |A riverside resort area on the Bukhan River in Chuncheon. It is known for rail bikes, rafting and cafe streets.
ui.ko: 강원 춘천 북한강변에 있는 휴양지다. 레일바이크와 래프팅, 카페 거리로 이름난 곳이다.
ui.en: A riverside resort area on the Bukhan River in Chuncheon. It is known for rail bikes, rafting and cafe streets.

ui.key: |A road along Dalmaji Hill in Haeundae, Busan. It is known for cherry blossoms in spring and night views of the coast.
ui.ko: 부산 해운대 달맞이고개를 따라 이어지는 길이다. 봄에는 벚꽃, 밤에는 해운대 해안 야경이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A road along Dalmaji Hill in Haeundae, Busan. It is known for cherry blossoms in spring and night views of the coast.

ui.key: |A road along Yeongdeok’s east coast in North Gyeongsang. It passes seaside villages and ports famed for snow crab.
ui.ko: 경북 영덕 동해안을 따라 이어지는 길이다. 대게로 알려진 영덕의 바닷가 마을과 항구를 지난다.
ui.en: A road along Yeongdeok’s east coast in North Gyeongsang. It passes seaside villages and ports famed for snow crab.

ui.key: |A road along the Seomjin River lined with azaleas. In spring pink blossoms follow the roadside, making it a well-known drive.
ui.ko: 섬진강 주변을 따라 철쭉이 피는 도로다. 봄이면 길가를 따라 분홍빛 꽃이 이어져 드라이브 코스로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A road along the Seomjin River lined with azaleas. In spring pink blossoms follow the roadside, making it a well-known drive.

ui.key: |A road around Gyeongpo Lake and Gyeongpo Beach in Gangneung, Gangwon. It runs between lake and sea and passes pine groves.
ui.ko: 강원 강릉의 경포호와 경포 해변 주변을 지나는 도로다. 호수와 바다 사이를 달리며 소나무 숲도 만날 수 있다.
ui.en: A road around Gyeongpo Lake and Gyeongpo Beach in Gangneung, Gangwon. It runs between lake and sea and passes pine groves.

ui.key: |A road around Sorae Port in Namdong-gu, Incheon. The area has tidal flats, a fish market and traces of an old narrow-gauge railway.
ui.ko: 인천 남동구 소래포구 일대를 지나는 길이다. 갯벌과 어시장, 옛 협궤 철도 자취가 남아 있는 곳이다.
ui.en: A road around Sorae Port in Namdong-gu, Incheon. The area has tidal flats, a fish market and traces of an old narrow-gauge railway.

ui.key: |A road circling Okjeongho Lake in Imsil, North Jeolla. Drivers pass lake and hills, and the morning mist and sunrise are well known.
ui.ko: 전북 임실 옥정호를 따라 도는 도로다. 호수와 산을 곁에 두고 달리며 아침 안개와 일출 풍경이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A road circling Okjeongho Lake in Imsil, North Jeolla. Drivers pass lake and hills, and the morning mist and sunrise are well known.

ui.key: |A road crossing the center of Mokdong in Yangcheon-gu, Seoul. It runs through a city district of apartment complexes and shops.
ui.ko: 서울 양천구 목동 중심부를 가로지르는 도로다. 아파트 단지와 상가가 이어지는 도심 길이다.
ui.en: A road crossing the center of Mokdong in Yangcheon-gu, Seoul. It runs through a city district of apartment complexes and shops.

ui.key: |A road crossing the middle of Hallasan, linking Jeju City and Seogwipo. A rest area and a wetland lie near the 1,100 meter point.
ui.ko: 제주 한라산 중턱을 가로질러 제주시와 서귀포를 잇는 도로다. 해발 1100미터 부근에 휴게소와 습지가 있다.
ui.en: A road crossing the middle of Hallasan, linking Jeju City and Seogwipo. A rest area and a wetland lie near the 1,100 meter point.

ui.key: |A road following the Seomjin River as it flows from the Jirisan area to the southern sea. Between Hadong and Gwangyang, cherry and plum blossoms line it in spring.
ui.ko: 지리산 자락에서 남해로 흐르는 섬진강을 따라 달리는 길이다. 하동과 광양 사이에서 봄에는 벚꽃과 매화가 피고 강 풍경이 아름답다.
ui.en: A road following the Seomjin River as it flows from the Jirisan area to the southern sea. Between Hadong and Gwangyang, cherry and plum blossoms line it in spring.

ui.key: |A road in Asan lined with ginkgo trees along the Gokgyo Stream. In autumn it becomes a golden tunnel for walking and photos.
ui.ko: 아산 곡교천을 따라 은행나무가 늘어선 길이다. 가을이면 노란 터널이 이어져 걷기와 사진 명소가 된다.
ui.en: A road in Asan lined with ginkgo trees along the Gokgyo Stream. In autumn it becomes a golden tunnel for walking and photos.

ui.key: |A road in Seogwipo, Jeju, running between Pyoseon and Seongsan. It is known as a spring drive where canola flowers and cherry blossoms bloom together.
ui.ko: 제주 서귀포 표선과 성산 사이 녹산로를 따라 달리는 길이다. 봄에는 유채꽃과 벚꽃이 어우러지는 드라이브 코스로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A road in Seogwipo, Jeju, running between Pyoseon and Seongsan. It is known as a spring drive where canola flowers and cherry blossoms bloom together.

ui.key: |A road lined with cherry trees in Cheongyang, South Chungcheong. It is a quiet spring drive during blossom season.
ui.ko: 충남 청양에 벚나무가 늘어선 길이다. 봄 꽃철에 한적하게 드라이브하기 좋다.
ui.en: A road lined with cherry trees in Cheongyang, South Chungcheong. It is a quiet spring drive during blossom season.

ui.key: |A road lined with cherry trees leading toward Ssanggyesa in Hwagae, Hadong. In spring the blossoms form a long tunnel loved by drivers.
ui.ko: 하동 화개 쌍계사 쪽으로 이어지는 벚나무 길이다. 봄이면 꽃터널이 십 리 넘게 이어져 드라이브 명소로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A road lined with cherry trees leading toward Ssanggyesa in Hwagae, Hadong. In spring the blossoms form a long tunnel loved by drivers.

ui.key: |A road lined with crape myrtle trees in Seocheon, South Chungcheong. In summer red blossoms decorate the roadside.
ui.ko: 충남 서천의 배롱나무가 늘어선 길이다. 여름이면 붉은 꽃이 길가를 장식한다.
ui.en: A road lined with crape myrtle trees in Seocheon, South Chungcheong. In summer red blossoms decorate the roadside.

ui.key: |A road lined with metasequoia trees in Damyang, South Jeolla. Tall straight trees stand on both sides of the road.
ui.ko: 전남 담양에 있는 메타세쿼이아 가로수길이다. 곧게 뻗은 나무가 길 양옆으로 늘어서 있다.
ui.en: A road lined with metasequoia trees in Damyang, South Jeolla. Tall straight trees stand on both sides of the road.

ui.key: |A road linking Busan and Geoje, South Gyeongsang, with cable-stayed bridges and an undersea tunnel. It is known for combining sea bridges with a tunnel under the water.
ui.ko: 부산과 경남 거제를 잇는 해상 다리와 해저터널 구간이다. 바다 위 사장교와 바닷속 터널로 이어진 도로로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A road linking Busan and Geoje, South Gyeongsang, with cable-stayed bridges and an undersea tunnel. It is known for combining sea bridges with a tunnel under the water.

ui.key: |A road passing between Gujwa and Songdang on Jeju. It is known for a stretch where nutmeg yew trees form a tunnel.
ui.ko: 제주 구좌읍과 송당 사이를 지나는 도로다. 비자나무 숲이 터널처럼 이어지는 구간으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A road passing between Gujwa and Songdang on Jeju. It is known for a stretch where nutmeg yew trees form a tunnel.

ui.key: |A road through central Jongno in Seoul. It links the Changdeokgung and Anguk areas and passes beside the palace.
ui.ko: 서울 종로 도심을 지나는 도로다. 창덕궁과 안국동 일대를 잇는 길로 궁궐 곁을 지난다.
ui.en: A road through central Jongno in Seoul. It links the Changdeokgung and Anguk areas and passes beside the palace.

ui.key: |A rocky mountain between Nowon-gu in Seoul and Namyangju in Gyeonggi. Large boulders near the summit stand out, with open views over northeastern Seoul.
ui.ko: 서울 노원구와 경기 남양주 사이에 솟은 바위산이다. 정상 근처의 큰 바위가 눈에 띄고 서울 동북쪽 조망이 트인다.
ui.en: A rocky mountain between Nowon-gu in Seoul and Namyangju in Gyeonggi. Large boulders near the summit stand out, with open views over northeastern Seoul.

ui.key: |A rocky mountain on the western side of central Seoul. The old city wall trail passes by, and the summit overlooks Gyeongbokgung and the city.
ui.ko: 서울 도심 서쪽에 있는 바위산이다. 한양도성 성곽길이 지나며 정상에서 경복궁과 서울 시내를 내려다볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A rocky mountain on the western side of central Seoul. The old city wall trail passes by, and the summit overlooks Gyeongbokgung and the city.

ui.key: |A rocky mountain rising in the middle of Mokpo. The summit gives views of the harbor and the islands beyond.
ui.ko: 전남 목포 시내에 솟은 바위산이다. 정상 일대에서 목포 항구와 다도해를 내려다볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A rocky mountain rising in the middle of Mokpo. The summit gives views of the harbor and the islands beyond.

ui.key: |A rocky mountain spanning Wanju in North Jeolla and Nonsan in South Chungcheong. This provincial park is known for its suspension bridge, cable car and autumn colors.
ui.ko: 전북 완주와 충남 논산에 걸친 바위산이다. 구름다리와 케이블카, 가을 단풍으로 알려진 도립공원이다.
ui.en: A rocky mountain spanning Wanju in North Jeolla and Nonsan in South Chungcheong. This provincial park is known for its suspension bridge, cable car and autumn colors.

ui.ko: 루틴의 하위 항목을 다시 연결할 수 없습니다.
ui.en: A routine's sub-items cannot be relinked.

ui.key: |A scenic coastal area at the southern tip of Yeongdo-gu, Busan. Cliffs, a lighthouse and forest paths are linked by a loop train.
ui.ko: 부산 영도구 남쪽 끝에 있는 해안 절경지다. 절벽과 등대, 숲길이 이어지며 순환 열차도 이용할 수 있다.
ui.en: A scenic coastal area at the southern tip of Yeongdo-gu, Busan. Cliffs, a lighthouse and forest paths are linked by a loop train.

ui.key: |A scenic drive along the sea and islands of Jindo, South Jeolla. It shows the island-dotted waters of the southwestern coast.
ui.ko: 전남 진도의 바다와 섬을 따라 달리는 경치 좋은 도로다. 서남해의 다도해 풍경을 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A scenic drive along the sea and islands of Jindo, South Jeolla. It shows the island-dotted waters of the southwestern coast.

ui.key: |A scenic hill on the Namhan River in Chungju. Tradition says the musician Ureuk played the gayageum here, and it was also the site of a battle in the Imjin War.
ui.ko: 충북 충주 남한강가 언덕에 있는 명승지다. 신라 우륵이 가야금을 탔다는 곳이며 임진왜란 때 신립 장군의 전투 장소로도 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A scenic hill on the Namhan River in Chungju. Tradition says the musician Ureuk played the gayageum here, and it was also the site of a battle in the Imjin War.

ui.key: |A science and technology university in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. Its large campus, near the research complex, holds labs and research buildings.
ui.ko: 대전 유성구에 있는 과학기술 특성화 대학이다. 연구 단지와 가까운 넓은 캠퍼스에 실험실과 연구동이 모여 있다.
ui.en: A science and technology university in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. Its large campus, near the research complex, holds labs and research buildings.

ui.key: |A science museum in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. Natural history and advanced science exhibits plus a planetarium let visitors learn hands-on.
ui.ko: 대전 유성구에 있는 과학관이다. 자연사, 첨단 과학 전시와 천체관이 있어 체험하며 배울 수 있다.
ui.en: A science museum in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. Natural history and advanced science exhibits plus a planetarium let visitors learn hands-on.

ui.key: |A sea bridge linking Songdo and Yeongjongdo in Incheon. Its cable-stayed towers are distinctive, and the drive crosses the Yellow Sea.
ui.ko: 인천 송도와 영종도를 잇는 바다 위 다리다. 사장교 형태의 주탑이 특징이며 서해를 가로지르는 드라이브로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A sea bridge linking Songdo and Yeongjongdo in Incheon. Its cable-stayed towers are distinctive, and the drive crosses the Yellow Sea.

ui.key: |A sea cliff on the west coast in Buan. Its rock layers look like stacked books, and it is known for sunsets.
ui.ko: 전북 부안 서해안의 해식 절벽이다. 책을 층층이 쌓아 놓은 듯한 암석과 일몰 풍경으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A sea cliff on the west coast in Buan. Its rock layers look like stacked books, and it is known for sunsets.

ui.key: |A seaside Buddhist temple in Gijang-gun, Busan. Tradition traces it to the Goryeo period, and it is notable for sitting right by the waves.
ui.ko: 부산 기장군 바닷가에 있는 사찰이다. 고려 시대에 창건된 것으로 전하며 파도 앞에 자리 잡은 모습이 특징이다.
ui.en: A seaside Buddhist temple in Gijang-gun, Busan. Tradition traces it to the Goryeo period, and it is notable for sitting right by the waves.

ui.key: |A seaside area around Wolmisan in Jung-gu, Incheon. It has amusements, a coastal promenade and the Wolmi Sea Train.
ui.ko: 인천 중구의 월미산 일대와 바닷가 지역이다. 놀이시설과 해안 산책로가 있고 월미바다열차를 탈 수 있다.
ui.en: A seaside area around Wolmisan in Jung-gu, Incheon. It has amusements, a coastal promenade and the Wolmi Sea Train.

ui.key: |A seaside hill on the south coast of Geoje. A windmill and blue sea make it a popular photo stop.
ui.ko: 경남 거제 남쪽 해안의 언덕이다. 풍차와 푸른 바다가 어우러져 사진 촬영 명소로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A seaside hill on the south coast of Geoje. A windmill and blue sea make it a popular photo stop.

ui.key: |A seaside village in Gangneung, Gangwon, known for sunrise viewing. Its railway station sits very close to the sea, and a sand clock park stands nearby.
ui.ko: 강원 강릉 바닷가의 마을로, 해돋이 명소로 알려져 있다. 기차역이 바다와 아주 가깝고 모래시계 공원이 있다.
ui.en: A seaside village in Gangneung, Gangwon, known for sunrise viewing. Its railway station sits very close to the sea, and a sand clock park stands nearby.

ui.key: |A seaside village in Namhae where terraced rice paddies step down a steep slope toward the sea. The farmland and the ocean make a distinctive view.
ui.ko: 남해군 남면의 바닷가 비탈에 계단식 논이 층층이 이어진 마을이다. 좁은 땅을 일군 농경 풍경과 바다가 함께 보인다.
ui.en: A seaside village in Namhae where terraced rice paddies step down a steep slope toward the sea. The farmland and the ocean make a distinctive view.

ui.key: |A seated stone Buddha on Gwanbong peak of Palgongsan in Daegu. A flat hat-shaped stone sits on its head, and many people come to make wishes.
ui.ko: 대구 팔공산 관봉에 있는 석조여래좌상이다. 머리 위에 갓 모양의 넓적한 돌을 얹은 모습으로, 많은 이가 소원을 빌러 찾아온다.
ui.en: A seated stone Buddha on Gwanbong peak of Palgongsan in Daegu. A flat hat-shaped stone sits on its head, and many people come to make wishes.

ui.key: |A seawall in Dangjin, South Chungcheong. The embankment road offers views of the Yellow Sea and farmland.
ui.ko: 충남 당진에 있는 방조제다. 바다를 막아 만든 둑길로 서해와 들판 풍경을 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A seawall in Dangjin, South Chungcheong. The embankment road offers views of the Yellow Sea and farmland.

ui.key: |A series of bridges connecting Changseon Island in Namhae with Samcheonpo in Sacheon, South Gyeongsang. The sea-spanning route links islands and is known for sunsets and night views.
ui.ko: 경남 남해군 창선도와 사천 삼천포를 잇는 여러 다리 구간이다. 바다 위 다리와 섬이 이어지고 일몰과 야경이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A series of bridges connecting Changseon Island in Namhae with Samcheonpo in Sacheon, South Gyeongsang. The sea-spanning route links islands and is known for sunsets and night views.

ui.key: |A set of floating artificial islands on the Han River beside Banpo Bridge. They hold cafes and event spaces and are lit up at night.
ui.ko: 반포대교 옆 한강에 떠 있는 인공 섬 형태의 복합 문화 공간이다. 밤에는 조명이 켜지고 카페와 전시 공간이 있다.
ui.en: A set of floating artificial islands on the Han River beside Banpo Bridge. They hold cafes and event spaces and are lit up at night.

ui.key: |A shrine housing the spirit tablets of Joseon kings and queens, listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its very long main hall and the royal ancestral rites are highlights.
ui.ko: 조선 왕과 왕비의 신주를 모신 사당으로 유네스코 세계유산이다. 긴 정전 건물과 종묘제례가 대표적인 볼거리다.
ui.en: A shrine housing the spirit tablets of Joseon kings and queens, listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its very long main hall and the royal ancestral rites are highlights.

ui.key: |A shrine to Admiral Yi Sun-sin in Asan, near where he spent his youth. It has a relics exhibition hall and gardens.
ui.ko: 충남 아산에 있는 이순신 장군의 사당이다. 장군이 어린 시절을 보낸 곳 가까이에 있고 유물 전시관과 정원이 있다.
ui.en: A shrine to Admiral Yi Sun-sin in Asan, near where he spent his youth. It has a relics exhibition hall and gardens.

ui.key: |A skywalk on a hilltop above the Namhan River in Danyang. Glass floors and a suspension walkway give views of the river and the town.
ui.ko: 충북 단양 남한강 위 산 정상에 설치한 전망대다. 유리 바닥과 구름다리에서 남한강과 단양 시내를 내려다본다.
ui.en: A skywalk on a hilltop above the Namhan River in Danyang. Glass floors and a suspension walkway give views of the river and the town.

ui.key: |A small hermitage on the shore of Ganwoldo in Seosan. At high tide it appears to float like an island, and at low tide it can be reached on foot.
ui.ko: 충남 서산 간월도 바닷가에 있는 작은 암자다. 물이 들면 섬처럼 떠 있고 썰물에는 걸어 들어갈 수 있다.
ui.en: A small hermitage on the shore of Ganwoldo in Seosan. At high tide it appears to float like an island, and at low tide it can be reached on foot.

ui.key: |A small island in Goheung, South Jeolla, once home to a national hospital for people with Hansen disease. It is now linked by a bridge, with the hospital history and coastal paths to see.
ui.ko: 전남 고흥에 있는 작은 섬으로 한센병 환자를 위한 국립병원이 있었던 곳이다. 지금은 다리로 연결되어 있고 병원 역사와 해안 산책로를 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A small island in Goheung, South Jeolla, once home to a national hospital for people with Hansen disease. It is now linked by a bridge, with the hospital history and coastal paths to see.

ui.key: |A small island in Sinan, South Jeolla, reached over a bridge. Its roofs and paths are painted purple, and it is known for lavender and aster flowers.
ui.ko: 전남 신안에 있는 작은 섬으로 다리를 건너 갈 수 있다. 지붕과 길을 보라색으로 칠하고 라벤더와 아스타 국화를 가꾼 섬으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A small island in Sinan, South Jeolla, reached over a bridge. Its roofs and paths are painted purple, and it is known for lavender and aster flowers.

ui.key: |A small island off Hwaseong. A seabed road opens at low tide twice a day so that visitors can cross on foot or by car.
ui.ko: 경기 화성 앞바다의 작은 섬이다. 하루 두 번 바닷길이 열려 걸어서 건널 수 있는 것으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A small island off Hwaseong. A seabed road opens at low tide twice a day so that visitors can cross on foot or by car.

ui.key: |A small island off Masan reached by boat. Forest paths and sea views make it a relaxed short outing.
