ui.ko: 마산 앞바다에 떠 있는 작은 섬으로 배를 타고 들어간다. 숲길을 걸으며 바다 풍경을 즐길 수 있다.
ui.en: A small island off Masan reached by boat. Forest paths and sea views make it a relaxed short outing.

ui.key: |A small island off Yeosu connected to the mainland by a breakwater. It has camellia woods and a coastal walking path.
ui.ko: 전남 여수 앞바다의 작은 섬으로 방파제로 육지와 이어진다. 동백나무 숲과 해안 산책로가 있다.
ui.en: A small island off Yeosu connected to the mainland by a breakwater. It has camellia woods and a coastal walking path.

ui.key: |A small island west of Jindo, South Jeolla, known for its beach and odd rock formations. Visitors enjoy the sunsets and quiet fishing village atmosphere.
ui.ko: 전남 진도 서쪽에 있는 작은 섬으로 관매도 해수욕장과 기암괴석이 알려져 있다. 노을과 한적한 어촌 마을 분위기를 즐길 수 있다.
ui.en: A small island west of Jindo, South Jeolla, known for its beach and odd rock formations. Visitors enjoy the sunsets and quiet fishing village atmosphere.

ui.key: |A small park on Daehangno in Seoul, named after its horse chestnut trees. It serves as a resting place at the heart of a street full of small theaters.
ui.ko: 서울 대학로에 있는 작은 공원이다. 마로니에 나무가 서 있고 소극장과 공연장이 많은 거리의 중심 쉼터 역할을 한다.
ui.en: A small park on Daehangno in Seoul, named after its horse chestnut trees. It serves as a resting place at the heart of a street full of small theaters.

ui.key: |A spiral road winding up a mountain in Cheongyang, South Chungcheong. Its curves and mountain views make it a popular drive.
ui.ko: 충남 청양에서 산을 감아 오르는 나선형 도로다. 굽이진 길과 산 풍경이 어우러진 드라이브 명소다.
ui.en: A spiral road winding up a mountain in Cheongyang, South Chungcheong. Its curves and mountain views make it a popular drive.

ui.key: |A spot in Yeongwol surrounded by river on three sides. It is known as the place where Joseon’s King Danjong was exiled, with a pine grove nearby.
ui.ko: 영월 남한강 상류의 세 면이 강으로 둘러싸인 곳이다. 조선 단종이 유배되었던 장소로 알려져 있으며 소나무 숲이 있다.
ui.en: A spot in Yeongwol surrounded by river on three sides. It is known as the place where Joseon’s King Danjong was exiled, with a pine grove nearby.

ui.key: |A square in Nampo-dong, Jung-gu, Busan. It is linked to the Busan International Film Festival and has handprints and street-food alleys.
ui.ko: 부산 중구 남포동의 광장이다. 부산국제영화제 개최지로 알려졌으며 영화인의 손도장과 먹거리 골목이 있다.
ui.en: A square in Nampo-dong, Jung-gu, Busan. It is linked to the Busan International Film Festival and has handprints and street-food alleys.

ui.key: |A steel walkway sculpture in Hwanho Park in Pohang. Visitors climb its spiral stairs for views of the sea and harbor.
ui.ko: 경북 포항 환호공원에 있는 철제 조형 전망 시설이다. 나선형 계단을 올라 바다와 항구를 내려다볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A steel walkway sculpture in Hwanho Park in Pohang. Visitors climb its spiral stairs for views of the sea and harbor.

ui.key: |A stepped street in Jung-gu, Busan. Its displays recall life during the Korean War refugee years and give a feel of old Busan.
ui.ko: 부산 중구에 있는 계단 거리다. 한국전쟁 피란 시절의 삶을 담은 이야기와 조형물이 있어 부산의 옛 모습을 느낄 수 있다.
ui.en: A stepped street in Jung-gu, Busan. Its displays recall life during the Korean War refugee years and give a feel of old Busan.

ui.key: |A stone-walled lane running along the Deoksugung Palace wall in Jung-gu, Seoul. It is a popular walk with autumn ginkgo trees and old buildings of the Jeongdong area.
ui.ko: 서울 중구 덕수궁 담을 따라 이어지는 돌담길이다. 가을 은행나무와 정동 일대의 옛 건물이 어우러져 산책로로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A stone-walled lane running along the Deoksugung Palace wall in Jung-gu, Seoul. It is a popular walk with autumn ginkgo trees and old buildings of the Jeongdong area.

ui.key: |A stream-side road in Jinhae, Changwon, South Gyeongsang, famous for spring cherry blossoms. Cherry trees form a tunnel along both banks, with bridges and walkways.
ui.ko: 경남 창원 진해에 있는 하천 길로 봄 벚꽃 명소다. 하천 양옆으로 벚나무가 터널을 이루고 다리와 산책로가 이어진다.
ui.en: A stream-side road in Jinhae, Changwon, South Gyeongsang, famous for spring cherry blossoms. Cherry trees form a tunnel along both banks, with bridges and walkways.

ui.key: |A street in Hwangnam-dong, Gyeongju. Renovated hanok houses hold cafes, restaurants and shops, close to the Daereungwon tombs.
ui.ko: 경북 경주 황남동의 거리다. 한옥을 고친 카페와 식당, 가게가 모여 있고 대릉원 근처에 있다.
ui.en: A street in Hwangnam-dong, Gyeongju. Renovated hanok houses hold cafes, restaurants and shops, close to the Daereungwon tombs.

ui.key: |A street in Samcheong-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul. Hanok houses, galleries and cafes sit near Bukchon and Gyeongbokgung.
ui.ko: 서울 종로구 삼청동의 거리다. 한옥과 갤러리, 카페가 모여 있고 북촌과 경복궁 가까이에 있다.
ui.en: A street in Samcheong-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul. Hanok houses, galleries and cafes sit near Bukchon and Gyeongbokgung.

ui.key: |A street in the Gaya culture area of South Gyeongsang. It evokes Gaya history and has trees and scenery along the way.
ui.ko: 경남 가야 문화권 지역에 있는 거리다. 가야의 역사를 떠올리게 하는 길을 따라 나무와 풍경을 즐길 수 있다.
ui.en: A street in the Gaya culture area of South Gyeongsang. It evokes Gaya history and has trees and scenery along the way.

ui.key: |A street in the Hyehwa area of Jongno-gu, Seoul. Its many small theaters make it known for plays and performances.
ui.ko: 서울 종로구 혜화동 일대의 거리다. 소극장이 모여 있어 연극과 공연으로 알려진 곳이다.
ui.en: A street in the Hyehwa area of Jongno-gu, Seoul. Its many small theaters make it known for plays and performances.

ui.key: |A street of old used bookstores in Dong-gu, Incheon. Bookshops and small workshops remain in its narrow alleys, giving the neighborhood a nostalgic feel.
ui.ko: 인천 동구에 있는 옛 헌책방 거리다. 좁은 골목에 책방과 작은 공방이 남아 있는 동네로 오래된 정취가 있다.
ui.en: A street of old used bookstores in Dong-gu, Incheon. Bookshops and small workshops remain in its narrow alleys, giving the neighborhood a nostalgic feel.

ui.key: |A street of used bookstores in Bosu-dong, Jung-gu, Busan. The shops began during the Korean War refugee era, and old books are still traded here.
ui.ko: 부산 중구 보수동에 있는 헌책방 골목이다. 한국전쟁 때 피란지에서 시작된 책방들이 모여 지금도 헌책을 사고판다.
ui.en: A street of used bookstores in Bosu-dong, Jung-gu, Busan. The shops began during the Korean War refugee era, and old books are still traded here.

ui.key: |A stretch of National Route 7 running north to south along Gangwon’s east coast. It is a coastal drive with the sea beside the road.
ui.ko: 강원 동해안을 따라 남북으로 이어지는 국도 7호선 구간이다. 바다를 곁에 두고 달리는 해안 드라이브 길이다.
ui.en: A stretch of National Route 7 running north to south along Gangwon’s east coast. It is a coastal drive with the sea beside the road.

ui.key: |A sub-plan can only be moved within its parent routine's period.
ui.ko: 하위 계획은 상위 루틴 기간 안에서만 옮길 수 있습니다.
ui.en: A sub-plan can only be moved within its parent routine's period.

ui.key: |A supertall mixed-use skyscraper in Jamsil, Songpa-gu. Its upper-level observation deck looks out over Seoul.
ui.ko: 서울 송파구 잠실에 있는 초고층 복합 건물이다. 높은 층의 전망대에서 서울 시내를 내려다볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A supertall mixed-use skyscraper in Jamsil, Songpa-gu. Its upper-level observation deck looks out over Seoul.

ui.key: |A suspension bridge linking Dong-gu and Nam-gu in Ulsan that crosses Ulsan Port. Its two tall towers holding the cables have become a symbol of the city.
ui.ko: 울산 동구와 남구를 잇는 현수교로 울산항 위를 지난다. 두 개의 높은 탑이 케이블을 지탱하는 모습이 도시의 상징처럼 보인다.
ui.en: A suspension bridge linking Dong-gu and Nam-gu in Ulsan that crosses Ulsan Port. Its two tall towers holding the cables have become a symbol of the city.

ui.key: |A suspension bridge linking Hadong and Namhae Island in South Gyeongsang. It crosses the water of Namhae and opened in 1973.
ui.ko: 경남 하동과 남해도를 잇는 현수교다. 1973년 개통했고 남해 바다 위를 건너는 길이다.
ui.en: A suspension bridge linking Hadong and Namhae Island in South Gyeongsang. It crosses the water of Namhae and opened in 1973.

ui.key: |A suspension bridge linking Yeosu and Gwangyang in South Jeolla. It spans Gwangyang Bay, is named after Admiral Yi Sun-sin and is lit at night.
ui.ko: 전남 여수와 광양을 잇는 현수교다. 광양만을 가로지르며 이순신 장군의 이름을 땄고 밤에는 조명이 비친다.
ui.en: A suspension bridge linking Yeosu and Gwangyang in South Jeolla. It spans Gwangyang Bay, is named after Admiral Yi Sun-sin and is lit at night.

ui.key: |A tall mountain in Gapyeong, Gyeonggi, among the higher peaks in the province. Its many valleys and falls draw hikers in summer and for autumn foliage.
ui.ko: 경기 가평에 있는 높은 산으로 경기도에서 손꼽히는 높이다. 계곡과 폭포가 많아 여름 산행과 가을 단풍으로 찾는다.
ui.en: A tall mountain in Gapyeong, Gyeonggi, among the higher peaks in the province. Its many valleys and falls draw hikers in summer and for autumn foliage.

ui.key: |A temple at the entrance of Seoraksan National Park in Sokcho, Gangwon. The large Unification Buddha stands out, and it is a gateway to Gwongeumseong and Ulsanbawi.
ui.ko: 강원 속초 설악산 국립공원 입구에 있는 사찰이다. 입구의 통일대불이 눈에 띄고 권금성과 울산바위로 가는 길목이다.
ui.en: A temple at the entrance of Seoraksan National Park in Sokcho, Gangwon. The large Unification Buddha stands out, and it is a gateway to Gwongeumseong and Ulsanbawi.

ui.key: |A temple at the foot of Gyeryongsan in Gongju, South Chungcheong. Tradition dates it to the Baekje period, and its forest approach and valley are pleasant.
ui.ko: 충남 공주 계룡산 자락에 있는 사찰이다. 백제 시대에 세워졌다고 전하며 입구의 숲길과 계곡이 아름답다.
ui.en: A temple at the foot of Gyeryongsan in Gongju, South Chungcheong. Tradition dates it to the Baekje period, and its forest approach and valley are pleasant.

ui.key: |A temple at the foot of Mt. Jogye in Suncheon. It is one of the Sansa mountain monasteries on the World Heritage list, known for the Seungseongyo bridge and plum blossoms.
ui.ko: 전남 순천 조계산 자락에 있는 사찰이다. 유네스코 세계유산인 한국의 산사 가운데 하나이며 승선교와 매화로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A temple at the foot of Mt. Jogye in Suncheon. It is one of the Sansa mountain monasteries on the World Heritage list, known for the Seungseongyo bridge and plum blossoms.

ui.key: |A temple at the foot of Mudeungsan in Gwangju. It is said to date to the Unified Silla period and sits along a forest path beside a valley.
ui.ko: 광주 무등산 기슭에 있는 사찰이다. 통일신라 때 창건된 것으로 전해지며 계곡을 따라 오르는 숲길이 이어진다.
ui.en: A temple at the foot of Mudeungsan in Gwangju. It is said to date to the Unified Silla period and sits along a forest path beside a valley.

ui.key: |A temple at the foot of Naejangsan in Jangseong, South Jeolla. It is especially visited in autumn for the maples reflected in its pond by Ssangyeru Pavilion.
ui.ko: 전남 장성 내장산 자락에 있는 사찰이다. 경내 쌍계루와 연못에 비친 단풍 풍경으로 가을에 많이 찾는다.
ui.en: A temple at the foot of Naejangsan in Jangseong, South Jeolla. It is especially visited in autumn for the maples reflected in its pond by Ssangyeru Pavilion.

ui.key: |A temple below Dalmasan in Haenam, South Jeolla. From its main hall you can watch the sun set over the sea and islands.
ui.ko: 전남 해남 달마산 아래에 있는 사찰이다. 대웅보전 너머로 바다와 섬 위로 지는 해를 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A temple below Dalmasan in Haenam, South Jeolla. From its main hall you can watch the sun set over the sea and islands.

ui.key: |A temple for Buddhist nuns on the slopes of Bukhansan in Gangbuk-gu, Seoul. It sits along a forest path and is also known for hosting foreign practitioners.
ui.ko: 서울 북한산 자락 강북구에 있는 비구니 사찰이다. 숲속 길을 따라 오르며, 외국인 수행자가 머무는 곳으로도 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A temple for Buddhist nuns on the slopes of Bukhansan in Gangbuk-gu, Seoul. It sits along a forest path and is also known for hosting foreign practitioners.

ui.key: |A temple in Byeonsanbando National Park in Buan. It is known for a fir tree path and a main hall with carved floral lattice doors.
ui.ko: 전북 부안 변산반도 국립공원에 있는 사찰이다. 전나무 숲길과 꽃창살이 있는 대웅보전으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A temple in Byeonsanbando National Park in Buan. It is known for a fir tree path and a main hall with carved floral lattice doors.

ui.key: |A temple in Cheongdo, North Gyeongsang, known as a monastic college for Buddhist nuns. It is noted for its pine-lined approach and tranquil grounds.
ui.ko: 경북 청도 운악산 자락에 있는 사찰로 비구니 스님이 공부하는 승가대학으로 알려져 있다. 소나무 숲길과 고즈넉한 경내가 특징이다.
ui.en: A temple in Cheongdo, North Gyeongsang, known as a monastic college for Buddhist nuns. It is noted for its pine-lined approach and tranquil grounds.

ui.key: |A temple in Goseong, Gangwon, said to have been founded in the Silla period. It lies near the civilian control zone and still bears marks of the Korean War, with Burimun Gate and Neungpagyo Bridge as sights.
ui.ko: 강원 고성에 있는 신라 시대에 창건되었다고 전하는 사찰이다. 민통선 가까이에 있어 한국 전쟁의 아픔이 남아 있고 불이문과 능파교가 볼거리다.
ui.en: A temple in Goseong, Gangwon, said to have been founded in the Silla period. It lies near the civilian control zone and still bears marks of the Korean War, with Burimun Gate and Neungpagyo Bridge as sights.

ui.key: |A temple in a valley of Mt. Cheonchuk in Uljin, traditionally founded in the Silla period. It is known for a rock reflected in its pond.
ui.ko: 경북 울진 천축산 계곡에 있는 사찰이다. 신라 시대에 창건된 비구니 절로 전해지고 연못에 비친 불영암 바위가 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A temple in a valley of Mt. Cheonchuk in Uljin, traditionally founded in the Silla period. It is known for a rock reflected in its pond.

ui.key: |A temple in the Seongbuk-dong valley of Seoul. It was converted from a former restaurant estate and offers quiet wooded paths and gardens.
ui.ko: 서울 성북동 골짜기에 있는 사찰이다. 옛 고급 요정 터를 절로 바꾼 곳으로, 조용한 숲길과 정원이 있다.
ui.en: A temple in the Seongbuk-dong valley of Seoul. It was converted from a former restaurant estate and offers quiet wooded paths and gardens.

ui.key: |A temple in the eastern valley of Gyeryongsan in Gongju, South Chungcheong. It is known for a Buddhist nuns college, and a cherry blossom road leads to it in spring.
ui.ko: 충남 공주 계룡산 동쪽 계곡에 있는 사찰이다. 비구니 승가대학이 있는 곳으로 알려져 있고 봄에는 벚꽃길이 이어진다.
ui.en: A temple in the eastern valley of Gyeryongsan in Gongju, South Chungcheong. It is known for a Buddhist nuns college, and a cherry blossom road leads to it in spring.

ui.key: |A temple in the foothills of Mt. Gaji in Ulju County, Ulsan, traditionally said to date from the Silla period. It is known for its wooded paths and valley stream.
ui.ko: 울산 울주군 가지산 자락에 자리한 비구니 사찰이다. 신라 시대에 창건된 것으로 전해지며 울창한 숲길과 계곡이 어우러진다.
ui.en: A temple in the foothills of Mt. Gaji in Ulju County, Ulsan, traditionally said to date from the Silla period. It is known for its wooded paths and valley stream.

ui.key: |A temple on Gayasan in Hapcheon, South Gyeongsang, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is known for the Janggyeong Panjeon halls that store the Tripitaka Koreana woodblocks.
ui.ko: 경남 합천 가야산에 있는 사찰로 유네스코 세계유산이다. 팔만대장경판을 보관하는 장경판전으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A temple on Gayasan in Hapcheon, South Gyeongsang, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is known for the Janggyeong Panjeon halls that store the Tripitaka Koreana woodblocks.

ui.key: |A temple on Jogyesan in Suncheon, South Jeolla, known as the Sangha Jewel temple among Korea’s three jewel temples. Old halls and quiet forest paths surround it.
ui.ko: 전남 순천 조계산에 있는 사찰로, 한국 삼보사찰 가운데 승보사찰로 알려져 있다. 오래된 전각과 호젓한 숲길이 어우러진다.
ui.en: A temple on Jogyesan in Suncheon, South Jeolla, known as the Sangha Jewel temple among Korea’s three jewel temples. Old halls and quiet forest paths surround it.

ui.key: |A temple on Mt. Banya in Nonsan. It is known for a tall stone Buddha statue called the Eunjin Maitreya.
ui.ko: 충남 논산 반야산에 있는 사찰이다. 높이 솟은 석조 불상으로 알려져 있고 은진미륵이라 불린다.
ui.en: A temple on Mt. Banya in Nonsan. It is known for a tall stone Buddha statue called the Eunjin Maitreya.

ui.key: |A temple on Mt. Cheondeung in Andong. Its Geungnakjeon hall is known as one of Korea's oldest surviving wooden buildings, and the temple is a World Heritage site.
ui.ko: 경북 안동 천등산에 있는 사찰이다. 극락전은 현존하는 오래된 목조 건물로 알려져 있고 유네스코 세계유산에 속한다.
ui.en: A temple on Mt. Cheondeung in Andong. Its Geungnakjeon hall is known as one of Korea's oldest surviving wooden buildings, and the temple is a World Heritage site.

ui.key: |A temple on Mt. Deoksung in Yesan. Its main hall is a wooden building from the Goryeo period designated a national treasure.
ui.ko: 충남 예산 덕숭산에 있는 사찰이다. 대웅전은 고려 시대 목조 건물로 국보로 지정되어 있다.
ui.en: A temple on Mt. Deoksung in Yesan. Its main hall is a wooden building from the Goryeo period designated a national treasure.

ui.key: |A temple on Mt. Duryun in Haenam. It is one of the Sansa mountain monasteries on the World Heritage list, with a path through cypress woods.
ui.ko: 전남 해남 두륜산에 있는 사찰이다. 유네스코 세계유산인 한국의 산사 가운데 하나이며 편백 숲길이 이어진다.
ui.en: A temple on Mt. Duryun in Haenam. It is one of the Sansa mountain monasteries on the World Heritage list, with a path through cypress woods.

ui.key: |A temple on Mt. Moak in Gimje, said to date from the Baekje era. Its Maitreya Hall is designated a national treasure.
ui.ko: 전북 김제 모악산에 있는 사찰이다. 백제 시대 창건으로 전해지며 미륵전이 국보로 지정되어 있다.
ui.en: A temple on Mt. Moak in Gimje, said to date from the Baekje era. Its Maitreya Hall is designated a national treasure.

ui.key: |A temple on Obongsan near Soyang Lake in Chuncheon, Gangwon. It is associated with the Goryeo-era scholar Yi Ja-hyeon and keeps its Hoejeonmun Gate and garden remains.
ui.ko: 강원 춘천 소양호 가까운 오봉산 자락에 있는 사찰이다. 고려 시대 이자현이 머문 곳으로 알려져 있고 회전문과 정원 유적이 남아 있다.
ui.en: A temple on Obongsan near Soyang Lake in Chuncheon, Gangwon. It is associated with the Goryeo-era scholar Yi Ja-hyeon and keeps its Hoejeonmun Gate and garden remains.

ui.key: |A temple on Odaesan in Pyeongchang, Gangwon, said to have been founded in the Silla era. Its nine-story octagonal pagoda and fir-lined path are well known.
ui.ko: 강원 평창 오대산에 있는 사찰로, 신라 때 창건했다고 전해진다. 팔각구층석탑과 전나무 숲길이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A temple on Odaesan in Pyeongchang, Gangwon, said to have been founded in the Silla era. Its nine-story octagonal pagoda and fir-lined path are well known.

ui.key: |A temple on Seonunsan in Gochang, North Jeolla. It is known for camellias in spring and for red spider lilies and foliage in autumn.
ui.ko: 전북 고창 선운산에 있는 사찰이다. 봄의 동백과 가을의 꽃무릇, 단풍으로 이름이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A temple on Seonunsan in Gochang, North Jeolla. It is known for camellias in spring and for red spider lilies and foliage in autumn.

ui.key: |A temple on Songnisan in Boeun, North Chungcheong, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The tall Palsangjeon hall and a large bronze Buddha statue stand out.
ui.ko: 충북 보은 속리산에 있는 사찰로 유네스코 세계유산이다. 높이 솟은 팔상전과 큰 청동 불상이 볼거리다.
ui.en: A temple on Songnisan in Boeun, North Chungcheong, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The tall Palsangjeon hall and a large bronze Buddha statue stand out.

ui.key: |A temple on Yongmunsan in Yangpyeong, Gyeonggi. An old ginkgo tree in its grounds is famous for golden autumn colors.
ui.ko: 경기 양평 용문산에 있는 사찰이다. 경내에는 오래된 은행나무가 있어 가을 단풍으로 유명하다.
ui.en: A temple on Yongmunsan in Yangpyeong, Gyeonggi. An old ginkgo tree in its grounds is famous for golden autumn colors.

ui.key: |A temple on a hillside by the East Sea in Yangyang, Gangwon. It is known for its sea-facing Haesu Gwaneum statue and Uisangdae pavilion.
ui.ko: 강원 양양 동해 바닷가 언덕에 있는 사찰이다. 바다를 향한 해수관음상과 의상대가 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A temple on a hillside by the East Sea in Yangyang, Gangwon. It is known for its sea-facing Haesu Gwaneum statue and Uisangdae pavilion.

ui.key: |A temple on the eastern slope of Jirisan in Sancheong, South Gyeongsang. It is known as a practice site for Buddhist nuns and sits beside a clear valley stream.
ui.ko: 경남 산청 지리산 동쪽 자락에 있는 사찰이다. 비구니 스님이 수행하는 곳으로 알려져 있고 계곡 풍경이 맑다.
ui.en: A temple on the eastern slope of Jirisan in Sancheong, South Gyeongsang. It is known as a practice site for Buddhist nuns and sits beside a clear valley stream.

ui.key: |A temple on the slope of Mt. Ungil in Namyangju. It is known for its view of the Dumulmeori river confluence, an old ginkgo tree, and a tea house.
ui.ko: 경기 남양주 운길산 중턱에 있는 사찰이다. 두물머리가 내려다보이는 전망으로 유명하며 오래된 은행나무와 찻집이 있다.
ui.en: A temple on the slope of Mt. Ungil in Namyangju. It is known for its view of the Dumulmeori river confluence, an old ginkgo tree, and a tea house.

ui.key: |A temple on the slopes of Mt. Biam in Jeonui, Sejong. It is an old temple known for ancient Buddhist stone carvings and monuments.
ui.ko: 세종시 전의면 비암산 자락에 있는 사찰이다. 삼국 시대 불상과 비석이 전해지는 오래된 절로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A temple on the slopes of Mt. Biam in Jeonui, Sejong. It is an old temple known for ancient Buddhist stone carvings and monuments.

ui.key: |A temple on the southern foothills of Jirisan in Hadong, said to date from the Silla period. Nearby are the Hwagae valley, tea fields and a well-known spring cherry road.
ui.ko: 하동 지리산 남쪽 자락의 사찰로 신라 시대에 창건된 것으로 전해진다. 화개 계곡과 차밭이 가깝고 봄 벚꽃길로도 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A temple on the southern foothills of Jirisan in Hadong, said to date from the Silla period. Nearby are the Hwagae valley, tea fields and a well-known spring cherry road.

ui.key: |A temporary royal palace inside Hwaseong Fortress in Suwon from the Joseon dynasty. King Jeongjo stayed here when visiting his father Crown Prince Sado's tomb.
ui.ko: 수원 화성 안에 있는 조선 시대 임금의 임시 궁궐이다. 정조가 아버지 사도세자의 묘를 참배하러 올 때 머문 곳이다.
ui.en: A temporary royal palace inside Hwaseong Fortress in Suwon from the Joseon dynasty. King Jeongjo stayed here when visiting his father Crown Prince Sado's tomb.

ui.key: |A theme park in Anseong that introduces the local tradition of made-to-order craftsmanship. It also has an observatory and play facilities.
ui.ko: 경기 안성에 있는 체험형 공원이다. 안성의 전통 유기 같은 맞춤 공예 문화를 소개하고 천문대와 놀이 시설이 있다.
ui.en: A theme park in Anseong that introduces the local tradition of made-to-order craftsmanship. It also has an observatory and play facilities.

ui.key: |A tidal flat and reed wetland in Suncheon, South Jeolla, listed as a Ramsar site. Migratory birds visit, and an observatory overlooks the S-shaped waterway.
ui.ko: 전남 순천에 있는 갯벌과 갈대밭 습지로 람사르 습지다. 철새가 찾아오고 전망대에서 S자 물길을 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A tidal flat and reed wetland in Suncheon, South Jeolla, listed as a Ramsar site. Migratory birds visit, and an observatory overlooks the S-shaped waterway.

ui.key: |A tourist site on the Imjin River in Paju, Gyeonggi, reflecting the history of national division. The Freedom Bridge, a memorial altar and Peace Nuri Park are nearby.
ui.ko: 경기 파주 임진강변에 있는 관광지로, 분단의 역사를 보여 주는 곳이다. 자유의 다리와 망배단, 평화누리공원이 가까이 있다.
ui.en: A tourist site on the Imjin River in Paju, Gyeonggi, reflecting the history of national division. The Freedom Bridge, a memorial altar and Peace Nuri Park are nearby.

ui.key: |A tower in Yongdusan Park, Jung-gu, Busan. Its observation deck overlooks Busan Port and the city center.
ui.ko: 부산 중구 용두산공원에 있는 탑이다. 전망대에서 부산항과 도심을 내려다볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A tower in Yongdusan Park, Jung-gu, Busan. Its observation deck overlooks Busan Port and the city center.

ui.key: |A traditional culture street in Jongno, Seoul. Galleries, craft shops and tea houses line the road, which suits a slow stroll.
ui.ko: 서울 종로에 있는 전통 문화의 거리다. 화랑과 공예품점, 찻집이 늘어서 있어 천천히 걸으며 구경하기 좋다.
ui.en: A traditional culture street in Jongno, Seoul. Galleries, craft shops and tea houses line the road, which suits a slow stroll.

ui.key: |A traditional folk village in Asan, South Chungcheong. Thatched and tile-roofed houses and stone-wall lanes remain, and residents still live there.
ui.ko: 충남 아산에 있는 전통 민속 마을이다. 초가와 기와집, 돌담길이 남아 있고 지금도 주민이 살고 있다.
ui.en: A traditional folk village in Asan, South Chungcheong. Thatched and tile-roofed houses and stone-wall lanes remain, and residents still live there.

ui.key: |A traditional hanok village in Sancheong lined with old stone-wall lanes. Historic houses and aged trees give it a tranquil feel.
ui.ko: 산청에 있는 전통 한옥 마을로 옛 돌담길이 이어진다. 고택과 오래된 나무가 어우러진 고즈넉한 풍경이다.
ui.en: A traditional hanok village in Sancheong lined with old stone-wall lanes. Historic houses and aged trees give it a tranquil feel.

ui.key: |A traditional market held every five days in Jeongseon. Visitors can taste mountain foods such as gondre rice and buckwheat crepes.
ui.ko: 강원 정선에서 닷새마다 열리는 전통 시장이다. 곤드레밥과 메밀전병 같은 산골 음식과 나물을 맛볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A traditional market held every five days in Jeongseon. Visitors can taste mountain foods such as gondre rice and buckwheat crepes.

ui.key: |A traditional market in Dong-gu, Gwangju, near the Gwangju Stream. It is known for its night market and food stalls involving local artists.
ui.ko: 광주 동구 광주천 근처에 있는 전통시장이다. 예술가들이 참여한 야시장과 먹거리로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A traditional market in Dong-gu, Gwangju, near the Gwangju Stream. It is known for its night market and food stalls involving local artists.

ui.key: |A traditional market in Jeonju. Its night market and local dishes such as bibimbap and bean sprout soup are popular.
ui.ko: 전북 전주에 있는 전통 시장이다. 야시장과 비빔밥, 콩나물국밥 같은 전주 음식을 맛볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A traditional market in Jeonju. Its night market and local dishes such as bibimbap and bean sprout soup are popular.

ui.key: |A traditional market in Jongno known for its street food. Stalls sell items such as mung bean pancakes and beef tartare, alongside fabric shops.
ui.ko: 종로에 있는 전통시장으로 먹거리로 널리 알려져 있다. 빈대떡, 마약김밥, 육회 같은 음식과 포목점이 모여 있다.
ui.en: A traditional market in Jongno known for its street food. Stalls sell items such as mung bean pancakes and beef tartare, alongside fabric shops.

ui.key: |A traditional market in Sinpo-dong, Jung-gu, Incheon. It is known for fried chicken, spicy cold noodles and dumplings, and lies close to the old open port.
ui.ko: 인천 중구 신포동에 있는 전통시장이다. 닭강정과 쫄면, 만두 같은 먹거리로 알려져 있고 개항장과 가깝다.
ui.en: A traditional market in Sinpo-dong, Jung-gu, Incheon. It is known for fried chicken, spicy cold noodles and dumplings, and lies close to the old open port.

ui.key: |A traditional market in central Sokcho. It is known for fried chicken, stuffed squid sausage, dried seafood and fresh fish.
ui.ko: 강원 속초 중앙동에 있는 전통 시장이다. 닭강정과 오징어순대, 건어물 등 먹거리와 해산물로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A traditional market in central Sokcho. It is known for fried chicken, stuffed squid sausage, dried seafood and fresh fish.

ui.key: |A traditional market in downtown Jeju City. Citrus, seafood and local street food are all found in one place.
ui.ko: 제주시 원도심에 있는 전통 시장이다. 감귤과 해산물, 제주 먹거리를 한곳에서 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A traditional market in downtown Jeju City. Citrus, seafood and local street food are all found in one place.

ui.key: |A traditional village at the foot of Namsan where several Joseon-era hanok houses were relocated. Visitors can stroll the gardens with pavilions and a pond.
ui.ko: 남산 기슭에 조선 시대 한옥 몇 채를 옮겨 놓은 전통 마을이다. 한옥과 정자, 연못이 있는 정원을 거닐 수 있다.
ui.en: A traditional village at the foot of Namsan where several Joseon-era hanok houses were relocated. Visitors can stroll the gardens with pavilions and a pond.

ui.key: |A traditional village in Andong, North Gyeongsang, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Nakdong River curls around it, and old yangban houses and thatched homes remain.
ui.ko: 경북 안동에 있는 전통 마을로 유네스코 세계유산이다. 낙동강이 마을을 휘감아 흐르고 옛 양반 가옥과 초가가 남아 있다.
ui.en: A traditional village in Andong, North Gyeongsang, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Nakdong River curls around it, and old yangban houses and thatched homes remain.

ui.key: |A traditional village in Pyoseon on Jeju, built around an old county fortress site. Thatched houses, stone walls and old trees show the island's past way of life.
ui.ko: 제주 표선면에 있는 전통 마을로 옛 제주 읍성 터를 중심으로 한다. 초가집과 돌담, 느티나무가 남아 있어 제주의 옛 생활을 보여 준다.
ui.en: A traditional village in Pyoseon on Jeju, built around an old county fortress site. Thatched houses, stone walls and old trees show the island's past way of life.

ui.key: |A traditional village of hundreds of hanok houses in central Jeonju, North Jeolla. It is known for traditional food such as bibimbap and for craft experiences.
ui.ko: 전북 전주 도심에 한옥 700여 채가 모여 있는 전통 마을이다. 비빔밥 등 전통 음식과 공예 체험이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A traditional village of hundreds of hanok houses in central Jeonju, North Jeolla. It is known for traditional food such as bibimbap and for craft experiences.

ui.key: |A tree-lined road in Cheongju, North Chungcheong. The trees on both sides form a canopy that changes with the seasons.
ui.ko: 충북 청주의 가로수길이다. 길 양쪽에 늘어선 나무가 터널을 이루어 계절마다 다른 풍경을 보여 준다.
ui.en: A tree-lined road in Cheongju, North Chungcheong. The trees on both sides form a canopy that changes with the seasons.

ui.key: |A tunnel under Jungnyeong between Yeongju and Danyang. The Jungang Expressway passes beneath Sobaeksan here.
ui.ko: 경북 영주와 충북 단양 사이에 있는 죽령을 뚫은 터널이다. 중앙고속도로가 소백산 아래를 통과한다.
ui.en: A tunnel under Jungnyeong between Yeongju and Danyang. The Jungang Expressway passes beneath Sobaeksan here.

ui.key: |A very old ginkgo tree in Munmak, Wonju, designated a natural monument. In autumn its huge golden crown and fallen leaves draw many visitors.
ui.ko: 원주 문막읍에 있는 수령이 오래된 은행나무로 천연기념물이다. 가을에는 노랗게 물든 거대한 나무와 낙엽이 장관을 이룬다.
ui.en: A very old ginkgo tree in Munmak, Wonju, designated a natural monument. In autumn its huge golden crown and fallen leaves draw many visitors.

ui.key: |A very old ginkgo tree in the grounds of Yongmunsa in Yangpyeong, designated a natural monument. Its great height and autumn color draw many visitors.
ui.ko: 양평 용문사 경내에 서 있는 아주 오래된 은행나무로 천연기념물이다. 높이가 매우 높아 가을 단풍 명소로 꼽힌다.
ui.en: A very old ginkgo tree in the grounds of Yongmunsa in Yangpyeong, designated a natural monument. Its great height and autumn color draw many visitors.

ui.key: |A very old ginkgo tree standing in a former village in the Yeongdeok area. Its yellow autumn foliage is the main attraction.
ui.ko: 영덕과 인근 지역 옛 마을에 서 있는 아주 오래된 은행나무다. 가을이면 노란 단풍으로 눈길을 끈다.
ui.en: A very old ginkgo tree standing in a former village in the Yeongdeok area. Its yellow autumn foliage is the main attraction.

ui.key: |A village by Cheongcho Lake in Sokcho settled by refugees from the north during the Korean War. It is known for its fermented flatfish dish and the hand-pulled ferry.
ui.ko: 강원 속초 청초호 가에 있는 실향민 마을이다. 한국전쟁 때 함경도에서 내려온 이들이 정착한 곳으로 가자미식해와 갯배로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A village by Cheongcho Lake in Sokcho settled by refugees from the north during the Korean War. It is known for its fermented flatfish dish and the hand-pulled ferry.

ui.key: |A village by the Seomjin River in Gwangyang filled with plum blossoms in early spring. Plum orchards and river scenery combine here.
ui.ko: 광양 섬진강 가에 있는 마을로 이른 봄 매화꽃이 가득 핀다. 매실 농가와 강 풍경이 어우러진다.
ui.en: A village by the Seomjin River in Gwangyang filled with plum blossoms in early spring. Plum orchards and river scenery combine here.

ui.key: |A village in Haenam, South Jeolla, at the southern tip of the Korean mainland. It has an observatory, a monument and ferries to nearby islands.
ui.ko: 전남 해남에 있는 한반도 육지 최남단 마을이다. 땅끝 전망대와 기념탑, 섬으로 가는 배편이 있다.
ui.en: A village in Haenam, South Jeolla, at the southern tip of the Korean mainland. It has an observatory, a monument and ferries to nearby islands.

ui.key: |A village in Icheon where pottery studios cluster. Visitors can try ceramics workshops and browse works in a town long known for its pottery.
ui.ko: 경기 이천 사기막골에 도자기 공방이 모인 마을이다. 도예 체험과 작품 구경을 할 수 있고 이천은 예로부터 도자기로 알려진 고장이다.
ui.en: A village in Icheon where pottery studios cluster. Visitors can try ceramics workshops and browse works in a town long known for its pottery.

ui.key: |A village in Namhae, South Gyeongsang, settled by Koreans returning from Germany. German-style houses blend with sea views.
ui.ko: 경남 남해에 있는 마을로, 독일에서 돌아온 교포들이 정착해 이룬 곳이다. 독일식 주택과 바다 전망이 어우러진다.
ui.en: A village in Namhae, South Gyeongsang, settled by Koreans returning from Germany. German-style houses blend with sea views.

ui.key: |A village in Sandong, Gurye, covered in yellow cornelian cherry blossoms in spring. The flowers color the slopes at the foot of Jirisan.
ui.ko: 구례 산동면에 있는 마을로 봄에 산수유꽃이 노랗게 핀다. 지리산 자락 마을 곳곳이 꽃으로 물든다.
ui.en: A village in Sandong, Gurye, covered in yellow cornelian cherry blossoms in spring. The flowers color the slopes at the foot of Jirisan.

ui.key: |A volcanic cone near Aewol in Jeju covered with silvergrass. From the top, Hallasan and the western plains are in view.
ui.ko: 제주시 애월읍 쪽에 있는 오름으로 억새가 많다. 정상에서 한라산과 서쪽 들판이 내려다보인다.
ui.en: A volcanic cone near Aewol in Jeju covered with silvergrass. From the top, Hallasan and the western plains are in view.

ui.key: |A volcanic island group in the East Sea administered by Korea as part of Ulleung County, North Gyeongsang. It consists of two main islets, East and West, and many small rocks.
ui.ko: 동해에 있는 화산섬으로 한국이 실효 지배하며 경북 울릉군에 속한다. 동도와 서도 두 섬과 작은 바위들로 이루어져 있다.
ui.en: A volcanic island group in the East Sea administered by Korea as part of Ulleung County, North Gyeongsang. It consists of two main islets, East and West, and many small rocks.

ui.key: |A volcanic island in the East Sea belonging to North Gyeongsang. It is known for coastal cliffs, Seonginbong peak and unusual rock formations, reached by ferry from ports such as Pohang.
ui.ko: 경북 동해에 떨어져 있는 화산섬이다. 해안 절벽과 성인봉, 독특한 기암이 알려져 있고 포항 등에서 배로 간다.
ui.en: A volcanic island in the East Sea belonging to North Gyeongsang. It is known for coastal cliffs, Seonginbong peak and unusual rock formations, reached by ferry from ports such as Pohang.

ui.key: |A volcanic rock on the Jeju City shore shaped like a dragon’s head. It was carved by waves over a long time and is easy to visit from the airport.
ui.ko: 제주 시내 바닷가에 있는 용 머리 모양의 화산암 바위다. 오랜 세월 파도에 깎여 생긴 모양으로, 제주공항에서 가까워 많이 찾는다.
ui.en: A volcanic rock on the Jeju City shore shaped like a dragon’s head. It was carved by waves over a long time and is easy to visit from the airport.

ui.key: |A volcanic tuff cone at the eastern end of Jeju, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It rises from the sea as a cliff, with sunrise and crater views from the top.
ui.ko: 제주 동쪽 끝에 있는 화산 분화구 지형으로 유네스코 세계유산이다. 바다에서 솟은 절벽 모양이며 정상에서 일출과 분화구를 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A volcanic tuff cone at the eastern end of Jeju, and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It rises from the sea as a cliff, with sunrise and crater views from the top.

ui.key: |A walking path built along the old Gyeongchun railway line. Rails and trees line the route, with some cafes and small shops along the way.
ui.ko: 옛 경춘선 철길 위에 만든 산책로다. 철로와 나무가 어우러진 길을 따라 걸으며 카페와 작은 가게도 만날 수 있다.
ui.en: A walking path built along the old Gyeongchun railway line. Rails and trees line the route, with some cafes and small shops along the way.

ui.key: |A walking route through old modern-era buildings and alleys in central Daegu. Visitors pass former churches, hospitals and houses that still stand.
ui.ko: 대구 중구 도심에 있는 근대 건물과 골목을 따라 걷는 길이다. 옛 교회와 병원, 집이 남은 곳을 둘러볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A walking route through old modern-era buildings and alleys in central Daegu. Visitors pass former churches, hospitals and houses that still stand.

ui.key: |A walking trail along the old railway in Hangdong, Guro-gu, Seoul. Trees and fields flank the track, making it a quiet place to stroll.
ui.ko: 서울 구로구 항동의 옛 철길을 따라 이어지는 산책로다. 철길 옆으로 나무와 들판이 있어 조용히 걷기 좋다.
ui.en: A walking trail along the old railway in Hangdong, Guro-gu, Seoul. Trees and fields flank the track, making it a quiet place to stroll.

ui.key: |A walking trail through the forest in Jeju’s mid-mountain highlands. Visitors stroll along a dirt path shaded by cedar and broadleaf trees.
ui.ko: 제주 중산간의 숲속을 따라 이어지는 산책길이다. 삼나무와 활엽수가 우거진 흙길을 걸으며 숲의 정취를 느낄 수 있다.
ui.en: A walking trail through the forest in Jeju’s mid-mountain highlands. Visitors stroll along a dirt path shaded by cedar and broadleaf trees.

ui.key: |A war museum in Yongsan covering Korean military history, including the Korean War. Military vehicles and aircraft are displayed outdoors.
ui.ko: 용산에 있는 전쟁 관련 기념관이다. 한국 전쟁을 포함한 전쟁사 자료를 전시하고 야외에는 군용 장비가 놓여 있다.
ui.en: A war museum in Yongsan covering Korean military history, including the Korean War. Military vehicles and aircraft are displayed outdoors.

ui.key: |A waterfall near downtown Seogwipo on Jeju Island. A walk through the wooded valley leads to the cascade, which drops not far from the sea.
ui.ko: 서귀포 시내 가까이에 있는 제주의 대표적인 폭포다. 계곡 숲을 따라 걸어 내려가면 바다로 가까운 곳에서 물줄기가 떨어지는 모습을 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: A waterfall near downtown Seogwipo on Jeju Island. A walk through the wooded valley leads to the cascade, which drops not far from the sea.

ui.key: |A waterfall on the Seogwipo coast whose water plunges from a cliff straight into the sea. It is one of Jeju’s well-known falls and is enjoyed together with the coastal scenery.
ui.ko: 서귀포 바닷가에 있는 폭포로, 물이 절벽에서 곧바로 바다로 떨어지는 것이 특징이다. 제주의 이름난 폭포 가운데 하나로 해안 풍경과 함께 감상한다.
ui.en: A waterfall on the Seogwipo coast whose water plunges from a cliff straight into the sea. It is one of Jeju’s well-known falls and is enjoyed together with the coastal scenery.

ui.key: |A well-known bakery whose main shop is in Eunhaeng-dong, Daejeon. People queue for its fried soboro bread and chive bread.
ui.ko: 대전 은행동에 본점을 둔 대표적인 제과점이다. 튀김소보로와 부추빵 같은 빵을 사려는 사람들이 줄을 서는 곳이다.
ui.en: A well-known bakery whose main shop is in Eunhaeng-dong, Daejeon. People queue for its fried soboro bread and chive bread.

ui.key: |A whale-themed village in Jangsaengpo, Nam District, Ulsan, once a whaling port. It has a whale museum and an ecology experience center.
ui.ko: 울산 남구 장생포에 있는 고래 테마 마을이다. 한때 고래잡이 항구였던 곳으로, 고래박물관과 생태체험관이 있다.
ui.en: A whale-themed village in Jangsaengpo, Nam District, Ulsan, once a whaling port. It has a whale museum and an ecology experience center.

ui.key: |A wide reed field near the Geum River estuary in Seocheon. Reeds sway in autumn winds, and it has appeared in films.
ui.ko: 서천 금강 하구 가까이에 있는 넓은 갈대밭이다. 가을 억새와 갈대가 바람에 흔들리고 영화 촬영지로도 알려져 있다.
ui.en: A wide reed field near the Geum River estuary in Seocheon. Reeds sway in autumn winds, and it has appeared in films.

ui.key: |A women’s university in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul. Its campus center, a sunken glass-sided corridor of steps, is a notable landmark.
ui.ko: 서울 서대문구에 있는 여자대학교다. 땅 속으로 이어진 유리 계단형 캠퍼스 복합 건물이 이름나 있다.
ui.en: A women’s university in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul. Its campus center, a sunken glass-sided corridor of steps, is a notable landmark.

ui.key: |Abu Dhabi is the capital of the United Arab Emirates, partly on an island in the Persian Gulf. The white marble Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is its signature landmark.
ui.ko: 아랍에미리트의 수도로 페르시아만의 섬 위에 있다. 흰 대리석의 셰이크 자이드 그랜드 모스크가 대표 명소다.
ui.en: Abu Dhabi is the capital of the United Arab Emirates, partly on an island in the Persian Gulf. The white marble Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is its signature landmark.

ui.key: |Addis Ababa is the capital of Ethiopia, set on a high plateau. It hosts the African Union headquarters and is known for its National Museum, markets and coffee culture.
ui.ko: 에티오피아의 수도로 고원 지대에 있다. 아프리카 연합 본부가 있으며 국립박물관과 시장, 에티오피아식 커피 문화로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: Addis Ababa is the capital of Ethiopia, set on a high plateau. It hosts the African Union headquarters and is known for its National Museum, markets and coffee culture.

ui.key: |Adjust the length so it stays within the period of the parent and child plans.
ui.ko: 상위·하위 계획의 기간을 벗어나지 않도록 길이를 조절해 주세요.
ui.en: Adjust the length so it stays within the period of the parent and child plans.

ui.key: |All records on this device and every BOKKI Plan backup file in iCloud Drive will be deleted. Once the backups are gone they cannot be restored, and this cannot be undone.
ui.ko: 이 기기의 모든 기록과 iCloud Drive의 BOKKI Plan 백업 파일이 모두 삭제됩니다. 백업을 지우면 복원할 방법이 없으며, 이 작업은 되돌릴 수 없습니다.
ui.en: All records on this device and every BOKKI Plan backup file in iCloud Drive will be deleted. Once the backups are gone they cannot be restored, and this cannot be undone.

ui.key: |Allow location access to record walking and running routes.
ui.ko: 위치 권한을 허용해야 걷기·달리기 경로를 기록할 수 있습니다.
ui.en: Allow location access to record walking and running routes.

ui.key: |Almaty is the largest city in Kazakhstan, at the foot of the Tian Shan mountains. A former capital, it is known for parks, mountain views and nearby ski areas.
ui.ko: 카자흐스탄 남동부 톈산 산맥 기슭의 최대 도시다. 옛 수도로 공원과 산악 전망, 근교 스키장이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: Almaty is the largest city in Kazakhstan, at the foot of the Tian Shan mountains. A former capital, it is known for parks, mountain views and nearby ski areas.

ui.key: |Altitude fluctuated by %.1f m, so calibration was cancelled. Stay in one place and try again.
ui.ko: 고도가 %.1fm나 흔들려 보정을 취소했습니다. 한자리에 선 채로 다시 시도해 주세요.
ui.en: Altitude fluctuated by %.1f m, so calibration was cancelled. Stay in one place and try again.

ui.key: |Amsterdam is the capital of the Netherlands, crisscrossed by canals. The Van Gogh Museum, the Anne Frank House and narrow canal houses are highlights.
ui.ko: 네덜란드의 수도로 운하가 도시를 둘러싼다. 반 고흐 미술관과 안네 프랑크의 집, 좁은 운하 주택이 볼거리다.
ui.en: Amsterdam is the capital of the Netherlands, crisscrossed by canals. The Van Gogh Museum, the Anne Frank House and narrow canal houses are highlights.

ui.key: |An activity category with this name already exists.
ui.en: An activity category with this name already exists.

ui.key: |An alley beside Bangcheon Market in Jung-gu, Daegu, with murals and artworks honoring the singer Kim Kwang-seok. It is a pleasant place to stroll.
ui.ko: 대구 중구 방천시장 옆 골목에 가수 김광석을 기리는 벽화와 조형물이 있는 길이다. 골목을 걸으며 구경할 수 있다.
ui.en: An alley beside Bangcheon Market in Jung-gu, Daegu, with murals and artworks honoring the singer Kim Kwang-seok. It is a pleasant place to stroll.

ui.key: |An altar at the summit of Manisan on Ganghwa Island. Legend says Dangun held rites to heaven here, and it is a designated historic site.
ui.ko: 강화 마니산 정상에 있는 제단이다. 단군이 하늘에 제사를 지냈다는 전설이 전해지며 사적으로 지정되어 있다.
ui.en: An altar at the summit of Manisan on Ganghwa Island. Legend says Dangun held rites to heaven here, and it is a designated historic site.

ui.key: |An altar where Joseon rulers held rites for the gods of land and grain. It lies west of Gyeongbokgung in Jongno-gu and was an important ritual site of the capital.
ui.ko: 조선 시대에 토지신과 곡식신에게 제사를 지내던 제단이다. 경복궁 서쪽 종로구에 있으며 도성의 중요한 제례 공간이었다.
ui.en: An altar where Joseon rulers held rites for the gods of land and grain. It lies west of Gyeongbokgung in Jongno-gu and was an important ritual site of the capital.

ui.key: |An amusement park and zoo at the foot of Bomunsan in Jung-gu, Daejeon. Rides, a zoo and a botanical garden are gathered in one place.
ui.ko: 대전 중구 보문산 자락에 있는 놀이공원과 동물원이다. 놀이 기구와 동물원, 식물원이 한 곳에 모여 있다.
ui.en: An amusement park and zoo at the foot of Bomunsan in Jung-gu, Daejeon. Rides, a zoo and a botanical garden are gathered in one place.

ui.key: |An amusement park in Dalseo-gu, Daegu. The 83 Tower is its symbol, and it is known for rides and night lighting events.
ui.ko: 대구 달서구에 있는 놀이공원이다. 83타워가 상징이며 놀이기구와 야간 조명 행사로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An amusement park in Dalseo-gu, Daegu. The 83 Tower is its symbol, and it is known for rides and night lighting events.

ui.key: |An amusement park in Gwacheon at the foot of Mt. Cheonggye. It offers rides, parades and seasonal events.
ui.ko: 경기 과천 서울대공원 안에 있는 놀이공원이다. 청계산 자락에 놀이기구와 퍼레이드, 계절 행사가 있다.
ui.en: An amusement park in Gwacheon at the foot of Mt. Cheonggye. It offers rides, parades and seasonal events.

ui.key: |An ancient temple on the Namhan River in Yeoju. Its brick pagoda standing on a riverside rock is its most recognized feature.
ui.ko: 경기 여주 남한강가에 있는 천년 고찰이다. 강변 바위 위에 세워진 벽돌탑 다층전탑이 대표 볼거리다.
ui.en: An ancient temple on the Namhan River in Yeoju. Its brick pagoda standing on a riverside rock is its most recognized feature.

ui.key: |An ancient temple on the slopes of Mt. Taehwa in Gongju. It is one of the Sansa mountain monasteries on the World Heritage list and sits in a valley forest.
ui.ko: 충남 공주 태화산 자락에 있는 천년 고찰이다. 유네스코 세계유산인 한국의 산사 중 하나이며 계곡을 낀 숲길이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An ancient temple on the slopes of Mt. Taehwa in Gongju. It is one of the Sansa mountain monasteries on the World Heritage list and sits in a valley forest.

ui.key: |An arborvitae forest near Dodong in Dalseong, Daegu, designated a natural monument. The trees grow naturally on a cliff slope.
ui.ko: 대구 달성 도동 마을 가까이에 있는 측백나무 숲으로 천연기념물이다. 절벽 위에 자생하는 희귀한 숲으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An arborvitae forest near Dodong in Dalseong, Daegu, designated a natural monument. The trees grow naturally on a cliff slope.

ui.key: |An area in the metalworking alleys of Mullae-dong, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, where artists gathered. Studios, murals and cafes mingle with working machine shops.
ui.ko: 서울 영등포구 문래동의 철공소 골목에 예술가들이 모여 만든 공간이다. 공장 사이에 작업실과 벽화, 카페가 섞여 있다.
ui.en: An area in the metalworking alleys of Mullae-dong, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, where artists gathered. Studios, murals and cafes mingle with working machine shops.

ui.key: |An artificial lake between Pyeongtaek and Asan. It is known for lakeside parks, walking paths and sunset views.
ui.ko: 경기 평택과 충남 아산 사이에 있는 인공 호수다. 호숫가 공원과 산책로, 일몰 풍경으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An artificial lake between Pyeongtaek and Asan. It is known for lakeside parks, walking paths and sunset views.

ui.key: |An artificial lake formed by damming the Namhan River in Chungju. It offers cruises, lakeside drives and views of the surrounding hills.
ui.ko: 충북 충주 남한강을 막아 생긴 인공 호수다. 유람선과 호반 드라이브 길, 주변 산과 어우러진 풍경이 있다.
ui.en: An artificial lake formed by damming the Namhan River in Chungju. It offers cruises, lakeside drives and views of the surrounding hills.

ui.key: |An artificial lake in Songpa-gu split into east and west parts. Its lakeside paths are popular, especially in cherry blossom season.
ui.ko: 송파구 잠실에 있는 인공 호수로 동호와 서호로 나뉜다. 호숫가 산책로와 벚꽃 풍경으로 사랑받는다.
ui.en: An artificial lake in Songpa-gu split into east and west parts. Its lakeside paths are popular, especially in cherry blossom season.

ui.key: |An artificial lake in the Bomun Tourist Complex in Gyeongju. It has lakeside walking and cycling paths and is popular in cherry blossom season.
ui.ko: 경북 경주 보문관광단지에 있는 인공 호수다. 호숫가 산책로와 자전거 길이 있고 벚꽃철에 많이 찾는다.
ui.en: An artificial lake in the Bomun Tourist Complex in Gyeongju. It has lakeside walking and cycling paths and is popular in cherry blossom season.

ui.key: |An artificial pond in Buyeo from the Baekje period, traditionally attributed to King Mu. It has lotus flowers and a pavilion.
ui.ko: 충남 부여에 있는 백제 시대 인공 연못이다. 무왕 때 조성된 것으로 전해지며 연꽃과 정자가 있다.
ui.en: An artificial pond in Buyeo from the Baekje period, traditionally attributed to King Mu. It has lotus flowers and a pavilion.

ui.key: |An artificial pond in Suseong-gu, Daegu. A walking trail, paddle boats and lakeside cafes make it a favorite place for strolls.
ui.ko: 대구 수성구에 있는 인공 연못이다. 둘레길과 오리배, 호숫가 카페가 있어 산책 장소로 사랑받는다.
ui.en: An artificial pond in Suseong-gu, Daegu. A walking trail, paddle boats and lakeside cafes make it a favorite place for strolls.

ui.key: |An artists’ village in Paju, Gyeonggi. Galleries, museums, workshops and cafes are gathered here.
ui.ko: 경기 파주에 조성된 예술인 마을이다. 갤러리와 박물관, 공방, 카페가 모여 있다.
ui.en: An artists’ village in Paju, Gyeonggi. Galleries, museums, workshops and cafes are gathered here.

ui.key: |An earthen fortress site inside Olympic Park in Songpa-gu, Seoul. Known as a Baekje-era fortification, it has a walking path along the earthen ramparts.
ui.ko: 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 안에 있는 토성 유적이다. 백제 때 쌓은 성으로 알려져 있으며, 흙 언덕을 따라 걷는 산책로가 있다.
ui.en: An earthen fortress site inside Olympic Park in Songpa-gu, Seoul. Known as a Baekje-era fortification, it has a walking path along the earthen ramparts.

ui.key: |An elevated walkway made from the old overpass in front of Seoul Station. Planters and trees line the path like a garden above the city.
ui.ko: 서울역 앞의 옛 고가도로를 보행길로 바꾼 공중 산책로다. 길 위에 화분과 나무를 심어 도심 속 정원처럼 꾸몄다.
ui.en: An elevated walkway made from the old overpass in front of Seoul Station. Planters and trees line the path like a garden above the city.

ui.key: |An exhibition and convention center in Centum City, Haeundae-gu, Busan. It hosts large fairs and international events, with department stores and film facilities nearby.
ui.ko: 부산 해운대구 센텀시티에 있는 전시컨벤션센터다. 대형 박람회와 국제 행사가 열리며 주변에 백화점과 영화 관련 시설이 있다.
ui.en: An exhibition and convention center in Centum City, Haeundae-gu, Busan. It hosts large fairs and international events, with department stores and film facilities nearby.

ui.key: |An expressway stretch beside the Geum River in the Okcheon area of North Chungcheong. Drivers follow the river and can rest at the service area.
ui.ko: 충북 옥천 일대의 금강 곁을 지나는 고속도로 구간이다. 강을 따라 달리며 휴게소에서 쉬어 갈 수 있다.
ui.en: An expressway stretch beside the Geum River in the Okcheon area of North Chungcheong. Drivers follow the river and can rest at the service area.

ui.key: |An international airport in Cheongju, North Chungcheong. It connects Cheongju with Jeju and other domestic cities, plus some overseas destinations.
ui.ko: 충북 청주에 있는 국제공항이다. 청주와 제주 등 국내 도시, 일부 해외 도시를 잇는다.
ui.en: An international airport in Cheongju, North Chungcheong. It connects Cheongju with Jeju and other domestic cities, plus some overseas destinations.

ui.key: |An international airport in Dong-gu, Daegu. It connects Daegu with Jeju and other domestic cities, plus some overseas destinations.
ui.ko: 대구 동구에 있는 국제공항이다. 대구와 제주 등 국내 도시, 일부 해외 도시를 잇는다.
ui.en: An international airport in Dong-gu, Daegu. It connects Daegu with Jeju and other domestic cities, plus some overseas destinations.

ui.key: |An international airport in Gangseo-gu, Busan. It connects Busan with domestic cities and overseas destinations such as Japan.
ui.ko: 부산 강서구에 있는 국제공항이다. 부산과 국내 도시, 일본 등 해외 도시를 잇는다.
ui.en: An international airport in Gangseo-gu, Busan. It connects Busan with domestic cities and overseas destinations such as Japan.

ui.key: |An international airport in Gangseo-gu, Seoul. It serves domestic routes such as Jeju and a few nearby overseas cities.
ui.ko: 서울 강서구에 있는 국제공항이다. 제주 등 국내선과 일부 가까운 해외 도시 노선을 잇는다.
ui.en: An international airport in Gangseo-gu, Seoul. It serves domestic routes such as Jeju and a few nearby overseas cities.

ui.key: |An international airport in Jeju City. It links Jeju with Seoul and other domestic cities, plus some overseas destinations.
ui.ko: 제주시에 있는 국제공항이다. 제주와 서울 등 국내 도시, 일부 해외 도시를 잇는다.
ui.en: An international airport in Jeju City. It links Jeju with Seoul and other domestic cities, plus some overseas destinations.

ui.key: |An international craft event held in Cheongju. Exhibits and workshops are shown in a repurposed former tobacco factory building.
ui.ko: 충북 청주에서 열리는 공예 분야 국제 행사다. 옛 연초제조창 건물을 활용한 전시장에서 공예 작품과 체험을 볼 수 있다.
ui.en: An international craft event held in Cheongju. Exhibits and workshops are shown in a repurposed former tobacco factory building.

ui.key: |An island at the mouth of the Han River west of Incheon, rich in Goryeo and Joseon history. It is known for dolmen sites, tidal flats, Jeondeungsa Temple and the Chamseongdan altar on Manisan.
ui.ko: 인천 서쪽 한강 하구에 있는 섬으로 고려와 조선 시대 역사가 깊다. 고인돌 유적과 갯벌, 전등사, 마니산 참성단으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island at the mouth of the Han River west of Incheon, rich in Goryeo and Joseon history. It is known for dolmen sites, tidal flats, Jeondeungsa Temple and the Chamseongdan altar on Manisan.

ui.key: |An island beside Yeongjongdo in Incheon, now reachable by car over a bridge. Hiking on Horyonggoksan and walks along the beach are popular.
ui.ko: 인천 영종도 옆에 있는 섬으로 다리가 놓여 차로 갈 수 있다. 호룡곡산과 해변이 있어 등산과 바다 구경을 함께 즐긴다.
ui.en: An island beside Yeongjongdo in Incheon, now reachable by car over a bridge. Hiking on Horyonggoksan and walks along the beach are popular.

ui.key: |An island city in Japan’s Yaeyama Islands, Okinawa. Clear seas and coral reefs make it a gateway to nearby islands.
ui.ko: 일본 오키나와현 야에야마 제도에 있는 섬 도시다. 맑은 바다와 산호초, 주변 섬으로 가는 배편의 관문이다.
ui.en: An island city in Japan’s Yaeyama Islands, Okinawa. Clear seas and coral reefs make it a gateway to nearby islands.

ui.key: |An island group between Jeju and the South Jeolla coast, administered by Jeju. It is known for fishing and its sea cliffs along the Navarone Sky Road.
ui.ko: 제주와 전남 사이 바다에 있는 섬으로 행정상 제주에 속한다. 낚시와 참굴비 조기로 알려져 있고 나바론 하늘길 해안 절벽이 볼만하다.
ui.en: An island group between Jeju and the South Jeolla coast, administered by Jeju. It is known for fishing and its sea cliffs along the Navarone Sky Road.

ui.key: |An island in Ganghwa County, Incheon, linked to Ganghwado by the Seokmo Bridge. It is known for Bomunsa Temple, Minmeoru Beach and sunsets.
ui.ko: 인천 강화군에 있는 섬으로 석모대교로 강화도와 이어진다. 보문사와 민머루 해변, 낙조로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island in Ganghwa County, Incheon, linked to Ganghwado by the Seokmo Bridge. It is known for Bomunsa Temple, Minmeoru Beach and sunsets.

ui.key: |An island in Hallyeohaesang National Park off Tongyeong, South Gyeongsang, divided into Daemaemuldo and Somaemuldo. The lighthouse islet near Somaemuldo can be reached on foot at low tide.
ui.ko: 경남 통영 한려해상국립공원에 속한 섬으로 대매물도와 소매물도로 나뉜다. 소매물도의 등대섬은 물때에 맞춰 걸어서 건널 수 있다.
ui.en: An island in Hallyeohaesang National Park off Tongyeong, South Gyeongsang, divided into Daemaemuldo and Somaemuldo. The lighthouse islet near Somaemuldo can be reached on foot at low tide.

ui.key: |An island in Japan’s Miyako Islands, Okinawa. It is a resort destination with clear water, long bridges and beautiful beaches.
ui.ko: 일본 오키나와현 미야코 제도의 섬이다. 투명한 바다와 긴 다리, 해변이 있는 휴양지로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island in Japan’s Miyako Islands, Okinawa. It is a resort destination with clear water, long bridges and beautiful beaches.

ui.key: |An island in Ongjin County, Incheon, easily reached by boat from Yeongjongdo. It is known for tidal flats, coastal trails and clam-digging experiences.
ui.ko: 인천 옹진군에 있는 섬으로 영종도에서 배로 가기 쉽다. 갯벌과 해안 산책로가 알려져 있고 조개 캐기 체험을 할 수 있다.
ui.en: An island in Ongjin County, Incheon, easily reached by boat from Yeongjongdo. It is known for tidal flats, coastal trails and clam-digging experiences.

ui.key: |An island in Ongjin County, Incheon, fairly large among the west sea islands. It is known for pines and soft sand at Seopo-ri Beach and the hike up Bijobong.
ui.ko: 인천 옹진군에 있는 섬으로 서해 섬 가운데 큰 편이다. 서포리 해변의 소나무 숲과 부드러운 모래, 비조봉 산행으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island in Ongjin County, Incheon, fairly large among the west sea islands. It is known for pines and soft sand at Seopo-ri Beach and the hike up Bijobong.

ui.key: |An island in Sinan at the far end of the western sea, designated as a natural monument. It is known for rock formations and boat tours around its coast.
ui.ko: 전남 신안 서해 끝에 있는 섬으로 천연기념물로 지정되어 있다. 기암괴석과 유람선 해상 관광으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island in Sinan at the far end of the western sea, designated as a natural monument. It is known for rock formations and boat tours around its coast.

ui.key: |An island in Sinan, South Jeolla, active in sun-dried sea salt production. It has Hanuneom and Wonpyeong beaches along with trails and tidal flats.
ui.ko: 전남 신안에 있는 섬으로 천일염 생산이 활발하다. 하누넘 해변과 원평 해변이 있고 섬 안에 산책로와 갯벌이 있다.
ui.en: An island in Sinan, South Jeolla, active in sun-dried sea salt production. It has Hanuneom and Wonpyeong beaches along with trails and tidal flats.

ui.key: |An island in Sinan, South Jeolla, with Taepyeong Salt Farm, one of the largest in the country. It is a Slow City and known for the mudskipper bridge and tidal flat scenery.
ui.ko: 전남 신안에 있는 섬으로 국내 최대 규모의 태평염전이 있다. 슬로시티로 지정되었고 짱뚱어다리와 갯벌 풍경으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island in Sinan, South Jeolla, with Taepyeong Salt Farm, one of the largest in the country. It is a Slow City and known for the mudskipper bridge and tidal flat scenery.

ui.key: |An island in Taean, South Chungcheong, connected to the mainland by a bridge. It is known for its pine forests, the sunset at Kkotji Beach with the Grandmother and Grandfather Rocks, and flower festivals.
ui.ko: 충남 태안에 있는 섬으로 다리로 육지와 이어진다. 안면 소나무 숲과 꽃지 해변의 할미할아비바위 일몰, 꽃 축제로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island in Taean, South Chungcheong, connected to the mainland by a bridge. It is known for its pine forests, the sunset at Kkotji Beach with the Grandmother and Grandfather Rocks, and flower festivals.

ui.key: |An island in Tongyeong, South Gyeongsang, formed by Sangdo and Hado. It is known for rocky ridge hikes with views across the island-dotted sea.
ui.ko: 경남 통영에 있는 섬으로 상도와 하도가 이어져 있다. 지리산 능선을 닮은 바위 능선 산행과 다도해 전망으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island in Tongyeong, South Gyeongsang, formed by Sangdo and Hado. It is known for rocky ridge hikes with views across the island-dotted sea.

ui.key: |An island in Wando, South Jeolla, reached by bridge. The scholar Yun Seon-do lived here and shaped gardens such as Seyeonjeong, and Yesong-ri pebble beach is well known.
ui.ko: 전남 완도에 있는 섬으로 다리로 이어진다. 윤선도가 머물며 세연정 등 정원을 가꾼 곳이고 예송리 몽돌 해변이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island in Wando, South Jeolla, reached by bridge. The scholar Yun Seon-do lived here and shaped gardens such as Seyeonjeong, and Yesong-ri pebble beach is well known.

ui.key: |An island in Yeosu with a cliffside walking trail called Biryeongil. It is known for sea views and hiking.
ui.ko: 전남 여수에 속한 섬으로 해안 절벽을 따라 비렁길이 이어진다. 바다 풍경과 걷기 여행으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island in Yeosu with a cliffside walking trail called Biryeongil. It is known for sea views and hiking.

ui.key: |An island in southern South Jeolla and the center of a county of many islands. It is known as the site of Jang Bogo's Cheonghaejin base in the Unified Silla era, and for beaches and abalone farming.
ui.ko: 전남 남쪽 바다에 있는 섬으로 여러 섬으로 이루어진 군이다. 통일신라 때 장보고가 청해진을 설치한 곳으로 알려져 있고 해변과 전복 양식으로 유명하다.
ui.en: An island in southern South Jeolla and the center of a county of many islands. It is known as the site of Jang Bogo's Cheonghaejin base in the Unified Silla era, and for beaches and abalone farming.

ui.key: |An island in the Gogunsan archipelago off Gunsan, connected to the mainland by bridges. It is known for its beach and rocky peaks.
ui.ko: 전북 군산 앞바다의 고군산군도에 있는 섬이다. 다리로 육지와 이어지고 해변과 봉우리 풍경이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island in the Gogunsan archipelago off Gunsan, connected to the mainland by bridges. It is known for its beach and rocky peaks.

ui.key: |An island in the North Han River near Chuncheon, Gangwon, reached by ferry from the Gapyeong side. Tree-lined paths of metasequoia and ginkgo run through it.
ui.ko: 강원 춘천 북한강에 있는 섬으로, 가평 쪽 선착장에서 배로 들어간다. 메타세쿼이아 길과 은행나무 길이 이어진다.
ui.en: An island in the North Han River near Chuncheon, Gangwon, reached by ferry from the Gapyeong side. Tree-lined paths of metasequoia and ginkgo run through it.

ui.key: |An island in the middle of the Bukhan River in Gapyeong. It has campgrounds and flower fields and is known for a jazz festival held in autumn.
ui.ko: 경기 가평 북한강 가운데에 있는 섬이다. 캠핑장과 꽃밭이 있고 가을에는 재즈 축제가 열리는 곳으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island in the middle of the Bukhan River in Gapyeong. It has campgrounds and flower fields and is known for a jazz festival held in autumn.

ui.key: |An island in the sea south of Yeosu, South Jeolla, known for its lighthouse and a 19th-century British occupation. It consists of three main islands: Dongdo, Seodo and Godo.
ui.ko: 전남 여수 남쪽 바다에 있는 섬으로 거문도 등대와 영국군 점령 역사로 알려져 있다. 동도, 서도, 고도 세 섬으로 이루어졌다.
ui.en: An island in the sea south of Yeosu, South Jeolla, known for its lighthouse and a 19th-century British occupation. It consists of three main islands: Dongdo, Seodo and Godo.

ui.key: |An island off Ansan in the Yellow Sea, linked to the mainland by the Sihwa seawall. It is known for tidal flats, vineyards and coastal drives.
ui.ko: 경기 안산 서해 바다에 있는 섬으로 시화방조제로 육지와 이어진다. 갯벌과 포도밭, 해안 드라이브 길이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island off Ansan in the Yellow Sea, linked to the mainland by the Sihwa seawall. It is known for tidal flats, vineyards and coastal drives.

ui.key: |An island off Geoje, South Gyeongsang, with a botanical garden. It is reached by sightseeing boat and is known for its seaside garden and sculptures.
ui.ko: 경남 거제 앞바다에 있는 섬으로 식물원 정원이 조성되어 있다. 유람선으로 가고 해상 정원과 조각 같은 조형물이 볼거리다.
ui.en: An island off Geoje, South Gyeongsang, with a botanical garden. It is reached by sightseeing boat and is known for its seaside garden and sculptures.

ui.key: |An island off Seongsan, Jeju, reached by ferry. Its name refers to a lying ox, and it has beaches, a lighthouse and a cycling loop.
ui.ko: 제주 성산 앞바다에 있는 섬으로 배로 들어간다. 소가 누운 모양이라는 이름이고 해변과 등대, 자전거 일주길이 있다.
ui.en: An island off Seongsan, Jeju, reached by ferry. Its name refers to a lying ox, and it has beaches, a lighthouse and a cycling loop.

ui.key: |An island off Tongyeong. Admiral Yi Sun-sin fought the Battle of Hansando here during the Imjin War, and the Jeseungdang shrine stands on the island.
ui.ko: 경남 통영 앞바다의 섬이다. 임진왜란 때 이순신 장군이 한산도 대첩을 치른 곳으로 제승당이 있다.
ui.en: An island off Tongyeong. Admiral Yi Sun-sin fought the Battle of Hansando here during the Imjin War, and the Jeseungdang shrine stands on the island.

ui.key: |An island off Wando. It is known for stone-walled lanes, rapeseed flower fields and slow walking trails.
ui.ko: 전남 완도 앞바다의 섬이다. 돌담길과 유채꽃밭, 느리게 걷는 슬로길이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island off Wando. It is known for stone-walled lanes, rapeseed flower fields and slow walking trails.

ui.key: |An island south of Hansando in Tongyeong, South Gyeongsang, where two parts are joined by a sandbar. It is known for its twin beaches and clear water.
ui.ko: 경남 통영 한산도 남쪽에 있는 섬으로 큰 비진도와 작은 비진도가 모래톱으로 이어진다. 두 개의 해변과 맑은 바다로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An island south of Hansando in Tongyeong, South Gyeongsang, where two parts are joined by a sandbar. It is known for its twin beaches and clear water.

ui.key: |An island south of Tongyeong, South Gyeongsang, known for sweet potatoes and fishing. Ilchulbong offers sea views, and a road circles the island.
ui.ko: 경남 통영 남쪽 바다에 있는 섬으로 고구마와 낚시로 알려져 있다. 일출봉에서 바다 전망을 볼 수 있고 섬 둘레 도로가 이어진다.
ui.en: An island south of Tongyeong, South Gyeongsang, known for sweet potatoes and fishing. Ilchulbong offers sea views, and a road circles the island.

ui.key: |An item cannot be linked to itself.
ui.en: An item cannot be linked to itself.

ui.key: |An observation tower near the Bomun Tourist Complex in Gyeongju. Its design draws on Silla-era architecture and offers high views over the city.
ui.ko: 경북 경주 보문관광단지 근처의 전망 탑이다. 신라 시대 건축 요소를 본뜬 모양으로 높은 곳에서 시내를 내려다볼 수 있다.
ui.en: An observation tower near the Bomun Tourist Complex in Gyeongju. Its design draws on Silla-era architecture and offers high views over the city.

ui.key: |An observatory near the demilitarized zone in Goseong, Gangwon. Visitors can look across to North Korean land and the mountain ranges toward Geumgangsan.
ui.ko: 강원 고성의 비무장지대 가까이에 있는 전망대다. 북녘 땅과 금강산 쪽 산줄기를 바라볼 수 있다.
ui.en: An observatory near the demilitarized zone in Goseong, Gangwon. Visitors can look across to North Korean land and the mountain ranges toward Geumgangsan.

ui.key: |An observatory on Mt. Odu in Paju, where the Imjin and Han rivers meet. It offers views across the river into North Korea and is a security-themed tourist site.
ui.ko: 경기 파주 임진강과 한강이 만나는 오두산에 세운 전망대다. 강 건너 북녘 땅을 볼 수 있는 안보 관광지다.
ui.en: An observatory on Mt. Odu in Paju, where the Imjin and Han rivers meet. It offers views across the river into North Korea and is a security-themed tourist site.

ui.key: |An old fortress on Ganghwado island in Incheon. Its walls served capital defense in the Goryeo and Joseon periods, and the east, west, south and north gates remain.
ui.ko: 인천 강화도에 있는 옛 산성이다. 고려와 조선 시대 도읍 방어와 관련된 성벽으로 동문, 서문, 남문, 북문이 남아 있다.
ui.en: An old fortress on Ganghwado island in Incheon. Its walls served capital defense in the Goryeo and Joseon periods, and the east, west, south and north gates remain.

ui.key: |An old ginkgo tree beside a historic Confucian academy in Gyeongbuk. Its autumn gold suits the quiet grounds.
ui.ko: 경북의 서원에 서 있는 오래된 은행나무다. 서원의 고요한 분위기와 가을 단풍이 잘 어울린다.
ui.en: An old ginkgo tree beside a historic Confucian academy in Gyeongbuk. Its autumn gold suits the quiet grounds.

ui.key: |An old ginkgo tree in Yogwang-ri, Geumsan, designated a natural monument. In autumn its yellow leaves color the village.
ui.ko: 금산 요광리에 있는 오래된 은행나무로 천연기념물이다. 가을이면 노란 잎이 마을 앞을 물들인다.
ui.en: An old ginkgo tree in Yogwang-ri, Geumsan, designated a natural monument. In autumn its yellow leaves color the village.

ui.key: |An old mountain pass on Seoraksan connecting Sokcho and Inje in Gangwon. Since a tunnel opened, the winding road is quiet and offers views of Seoraksan.
ui.ko: 강원 속초와 인제를 잇는 설악산의 옛 고갯길이다. 지금은 터널이 생겨 한적하며 굽은 길과 설악산 전망이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An old mountain pass on Seoraksan connecting Sokcho and Inje in Gangwon. Since a tunnel opened, the winding road is quiet and offers views of Seoraksan.

ui.key: |An old mountain pass over Mt. Joryeong in Mungyeong. It once linked Yeongnam to Hanyang in the Joseon era and is now a walking trail through forest.
ui.ko: 경북 문경 조령산을 넘는 옛 고갯길이다. 조선 시대 영남과 한양을 잇던 길로 지금은 숲길로 걸을 수 있다.
ui.en: An old mountain pass over Mt. Joryeong in Mungyeong. It once linked Yeongnam to Hanyang in the Joseon era and is now a walking trail through forest.

ui.key: |An old neighborhood in Yangnim-dong, Nam-gu, Gwangju. Worn houses and installations along the alleys make wandering the lanes the main attraction.
ui.ko: 광주 남구 양림동에 있는 오래된 동네다. 낡은 집과 골목에 설치된 조형물이 이어져 있어 골목 구경이 주된 재미다.
ui.en: An old neighborhood in Yangnim-dong, Nam-gu, Gwangju. Worn houses and installations along the alleys make wandering the lanes the main attraction.

ui.key: |An old pass road that once linked Pyeongchang and Gangneung in Gangwon. Forest paths and a valley follow it, and it keeps the feel of the old route between east and west.
ui.ko: 강원 평창과 강릉을 잇던 옛 고갯길이다. 숲길과 계곡이 이어지고 예전 영동과 영서를 넘던 길의 정취가 남아 있다.
ui.en: An old pass road that once linked Pyeongchang and Gangneung in Gangwon. Forest paths and a valley follow it, and it keeps the feel of the old route between east and west.

ui.key: |An old path along the edge of Goesan Lake in Goesan. The trail runs between hillside and water, with a suspension bridge and viewpoints.
ui.ko: 충북 괴산 괴산호 가장자리를 따라 이어지는 옛길이다. 산자락과 호수 사이로 걷는 산책로로 출렁다리와 전망대가 있다.
ui.en: An old path along the edge of Goesan Lake in Goesan. The trail runs between hillside and water, with a suspension bridge and viewpoints.

ui.key: |An old pavilion on a hill beside Gyeongpo Lake in Gangneung, Gangwon. It overlooks the lake, the East Sea and a pine forest.
ui.ko: 강원 강릉 경포호 옆 언덕에 서 있는 옛 누각이다. 호수와 동해, 소나무 숲이 함께 내려다보인다.
ui.en: An old pavilion on a hill beside Gyeongpo Lake in Gangneung, Gangwon. It overlooks the lake, the East Sea and a pine forest.

ui.key: |An old railroad village in Gyeongam-dong, Gunsan. Weathered houses line both sides of the track, drawing visitors for retro photos and costume rental.
ui.ko: 전북 군산 경암동에 있는 옛 철길 마을이다. 기찻길 양옆에 낡은 집들이 이어져 옛 교복 체험과 사진 촬영으로 찾는다.
ui.en: An old railroad village in Gyeongam-dong, Gunsan. Weathered houses line both sides of the track, drawing visitors for retro photos and costume rental.

ui.key: |An old reservoir in Jecheon, North Chungcheong, said to date back to the Three Han period. Pine trees and a walking path line its shore.
ui.ko: 충북 제천에 있는 오래된 저수지로, 삼한 시대에 만들어졌다고 전해진다. 호숫가 소나무와 산책로가 어우러진다.
ui.en: An old reservoir in Jecheon, North Chungcheong, said to date back to the Three Han period. Pine trees and a walking path line its shore.

ui.key: |An old reservoir in the Juwangsan area of Cheongsong, with willow trees growing in the water. It is known for misty early mornings.
ui.ko: 청송 주왕산 자락에 있는 오래된 저수지로 물속에 자라는 왕버들이 특징이다. 이른 아침 물안개 풍경으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An old reservoir in the Juwangsan area of Cheongsong, with willow trees growing in the water. It is known for misty early mornings.

ui.key: |An old residential area west of Gyeongbokgung. Hanok houses, narrow lanes, small shops and galleries sit side by side.
ui.ko: 경복궁 서쪽의 오래된 주택가 동네다. 한옥과 좁은 골목, 작은 가게와 갤러리가 어우러진다.
ui.en: An old residential area west of Gyeongbokgung. Hanok houses, narrow lanes, small shops and galleries sit side by side.

ui.key: |An old road over Jungnyeong Pass between Yeongju in North Gyeongsang and Danyang in North Chungcheong. The pass is known as an ancient route.
ui.ko: 경북 영주와 충북 단양 사이의 죽령을 넘는 옛길이다. 삼국 시대부터 이어진 고갯길로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An old road over Jungnyeong Pass between Yeongju in North Gyeongsang and Danyang in North Chungcheong. The pass is known as an ancient route.

ui.key: |An old stone bridge in Jincheon, North Chungcheong. Said to date from the Goryeo period, its long stone piers stretch across the stream like a centipede.
ui.ko: 충북 진천에 있는 옛 돌다리다. 고려 시대에 놓은 것으로 전해지며 긴 돌 교각이 지네 모양처럼 이어진다.
ui.en: An old stone bridge in Jincheon, North Chungcheong. Said to date from the Goryeo period, its long stone piers stretch across the stream like a centipede.

ui.key: |An old temple on the southern side of Jirisan in Gurye, South Jeolla. The nearby reservoir and forest paths make for quiet walks.
ui.ko: 전남 구례 지리산 남쪽에 있는 오래된 사찰이다. 근처 저수지와 숲길이 조용해 산책하기 좋다.
ui.en: An old temple on the southern side of Jirisan in Gurye, South Jeolla. The nearby reservoir and forest paths make for quiet walks.

ui.key: |An old traditional market in Seochon, Jongno-gu, Seoul. It is known for a lunchbox cafe where visitors swap coins for side dishes and food.
ui.ko: 서울 종로구 서촌에 있는 오래된 전통시장이다. 엽전을 바꿔 반찬과 음식을 사는 도시락 카페가 알려져 있다.
ui.en: An old traditional market in Seochon, Jongno-gu, Seoul. It is known for a lunchbox cafe where visitors swap coins for side dishes and food.

ui.key: |An urban forest park near Yangjaecheon in Seocho-gu, Seoul. Dense trees and walking paths run through it alongside memorials and sports facilities.
ui.ko: 서울 서초구 양재천 가까이에 있는 도심 숲 공원이다. 나무가 울창하고 산책로가 이어지며 기념 시설과 체육 공간도 있다.
ui.en: An urban forest park near Yangjaecheon in Seocho-gu, Seoul. Dense trees and walking paths run through it alongside memorials and sports facilities.

ui.key: |An urban park at the heart of Songdo International City in Incheon. A seawater canal winds among high-rise buildings.
ui.ko: 인천 송도국제도시 중심에 있는 도시 공원이다. 바닷물을 끌어들인 수로와 고층 건물이 어우러진다.
ui.en: An urban park at the heart of Songdo International City in Incheon. A seawater canal winds among high-rise buildings.

ui.key: |An urban park beside the National Museum of Korea in Yongsan-gu, Seoul. Broad lawns, a pond and trails make it a place for family outings.
ui.ko: 서울 용산구 국립중앙박물관 곁에 있는 도심 공원이다. 넓은 잔디밭과 연못, 산책로가 있어 가족 나들이 장소로 쓰인다.
ui.en: An urban park beside the National Museum of Korea in Yongsan-gu, Seoul. Broad lawns, a pond and trails make it a place for family outings.

ui.key: |An urban park in the center of Yeouido, Seoul. Lawns, woods and a pond make it a place for office workers and residents to walk and rest.
ui.ko: 서울 여의도의 중심에 있는 도심 공원이다. 잔디밭과 숲, 연못이 있어 직장인과 시민이 산책하고 쉬어 간다.
ui.en: An urban park in the center of Yeouido, Seoul. Lawns, woods and a pond make it a place for office workers and residents to walk and rest.

ui.key: |An urban theme park in Jamsil. An indoor amusement area connects with the outdoor Magic Island, and a folk museum is also on site.
ui.ko: 잠실에 있는 도심형 테마파크다. 실내 놀이공원과 야외 매직 아일랜드가 이어져 있고 민속박물관도 함께 있다.
ui.en: An urban theme park in Jamsil. An indoor amusement area connects with the outdoor Magic Island, and a folk museum is also on site.

ui.en: App usage integration is unavailable on this device.

ui.key: |Astana is the capital of Kazakhstan, on the northern steppe. Its distinctive modern architecture and the Baiterek tower shape the skyline.
ui.ko: 카자흐스탄의 수도로 북부 초원 지대에 있다. 독특한 현대 건축물과 바이테렉 탑이 도시 경관을 이룬다.
ui.en: Astana is the capital of Kazakhstan, on the northern steppe. Its distinctive modern architecture and the Baiterek tower shape the skyline.

ui.key: |Athens is the capital of Greece and a cradle of Western civilization. The Acropolis, the Parthenon and the Ancient Agora are its key ruins.
ui.ko: 그리스의 수도로 서양 문명의 발상지 중 하나다. 아크로폴리스와 파르테논 신전, 고대 아고라가 대표 유적이다.
ui.en: Athens is the capital of Greece and a cradle of Western civilization. The Acropolis, the Parthenon and the Ancient Agora are its key ruins.

ui.key: |Atlanta is the capital of Georgia in the southeastern United States. It has a major airport hub, the Martin Luther King Jr. National Historical Park and the Georgia Aquarium.
ui.ko: 미국 남동부 조지아주의 주도다. 세계적 허브 공항이 있으며 마틴 루서 킹 국립역사지구와 조지아 수족관이 있다.
ui.en: Atlanta is the capital of Georgia in the southeastern United States. It has a major airport hub, the Martin Luther King Jr. National Historical Park and the Georgia Aquarium.

ui.key: |Auckland is the largest city on New Zealand’s North Island, set between two harbors. The Sky Tower, volcanic hills and harbor sailing scenes are well known.
ui.ko: 뉴질랜드 북섬의 최대 도시로 두 개의 항구 사이에 있다. 스카이 타워와 화산 언덕, 항구의 요트 풍경이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: Auckland is the largest city on New Zealand’s North Island, set between two harbors. The Sky Tower, volcanic hills and harbor sailing scenes are well known.

ui.key: |Bali is an Indonesian island with a living Hindu culture. Beaches, terraced rice fields and sea temples are its highlights.
ui.ko: 인도네시아의 힌두교 문화가 이어지는 섬이다. 해변과 계단식 논, 바다 사원이 볼거리다.
ui.en: Bali is an Indonesian island with a living Hindu culture. Beaches, terraced rice fields and sea temples are its highlights.

ui.key: |Bangkok is the capital of Thailand, set along the Chao Phraya River. It is known for the Grand Palace, temples such as Wat Arun, floating markets and street food.
ui.ko: 태국의 수도로 짜오프라야강을 끼고 있다. 왕궁과 왓 아룬 같은 사원, 수상 시장과 길거리 음식이 유명하다.
ui.en: Bangkok is the capital of Thailand, set along the Chao Phraya River. It is known for the Grand Palace, temples such as Wat Arun, floating markets and street food.

ui.key: |Barcelona is a Mediterranean city in Catalonia, Spain. It is known for Gaudí’s Sagrada Família and Park Güell, and for its Gothic Quarter.
ui.ko: 스페인 카탈루냐의 지중해 연안 도시다. 가우디가 설계한 사그라다 파밀리아와 구엘 공원, 고딕 지구가 알려져 있다.
ui.en: Barcelona is a Mediterranean city in Catalonia, Spain. It is known for Gaudí’s Sagrada Família and Park Güell, and for its Gothic Quarter.

ui.key: |Batam is an island in Indonesia’s Riau Islands, a short ferry ride from Singapore. Resorts and seafood restaurants make it a popular short getaway.
ui.ko: 인도네시아 리아우 제도의 섬으로 싱가포르에서 배로 가깝다. 리조트와 해산물 식당이 있어 짧은 휴양지로 찾는다.
ui.en: Batam is an island in Indonesia’s Riau Islands, a short ferry ride from Singapore. Resorts and seafood restaurants make it a popular short getaway.

ui.key: |Bohol is an island in the Visayas of the Philippines. It is known for the cone-shaped Chocolate Hills and the tiny tarsier.
ui.ko: 필리핀 비사야 제도의 섬이다. 언덕이 원뿔 모양으로 늘어선 초콜릿 힐스와 안경원숭이로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: Bohol is an island in the Visayas of the Philippines. It is known for the cone-shaped Chocolate Hills and the tiny tarsier.

ui.key: |Boracay is a small island in the central Visayas of the Philippines. It is known for fine white sand at White Beach and its sunsets.
ui.ko: 필리핀 중부 비사야 제도의 작은 섬이다. 고운 흰 모래의 화이트 비치와 해 질 녘 풍경이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: Boracay is a small island in the central Visayas of the Philippines. It is known for fine white sand at White Beach and its sunsets.

ui.key: |Boston is the capital of Massachusetts, with deep roots in the American Revolution. The Freedom Trail, nearby Harvard University and Fenway Park are well known.
ui.ko: 미국 매사추세츠주의 주도로 독립 혁명의 역사가 깊다. 프리덤 트레일과 하버드 대학, 펜웨이 파크가 알려져 있다.
ui.en: Boston is the capital of Massachusetts, with deep roots in the American Revolution. The Freedom Trail, nearby Harvard University and Fenway Park are well known.

ui.key: |Brisbane is the capital of Queensland, Australia, along the Brisbane River. It has a subtropical climate, riverside parks and koala sanctuaries.
ui.ko: 오스트레일리아 퀸즐랜드주의 주도로 브리즈번강을 끼고 있다. 아열대 기후이며 강변 공원과 코알라 보호구역이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: Brisbane is the capital of Queensland, Australia, along the Brisbane River. It has a subtropical climate, riverside parks and koala sanctuaries.

ui.key: |Budapest is the capital of Hungary, divided by the Danube into Buda and Pest. The Parliament building, thermal baths and riverside night views are well known.
ui.ko: 헝가리의 수도로 도나우강을 사이에 두고 부다와 페슈트로 나뉜다. 국회의사당과 온천, 강변 야경이 유명하다.
ui.en: Budapest is the capital of Hungary, divided by the Danube into Buda and Pest. The Parliament building, thermal baths and riverside night views are well known.

ui.key: |Cebu is an island and city in the central Visayas of the Philippines. It has Spanish-era landmarks and is known for diving and whale shark encounters nearby.
ui.ko: 필리핀 중부 비사야 제도의 섬이자 도시다. 스페인 시대 유적과 인근 바다의 다이빙, 고래상어 관광으로 알려져 있다.
ui.en: Cebu is an island and city in the central Visayas of the Philippines. It has Spanish-era landmarks and is known for diving and whale shark encounters nearby.

ui.key: |Chiang Mai is a city in northern Thailand and the old capital of the Lanna Kingdom. Its walled old town has many temples and night markets, with mountains and elephant sanctuaries nearby.
ui.ko: 태국 북부 산악 지대의 옛 란나 왕국 도시다. 구시가지의 사원과 야시장, 주변 산지의 코끼리 보호 시설이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: Chiang Mai is a city in northern Thailand and the old capital of the Lanna Kingdom. Its walled old town has many temples and night markets, with mountains and elephant sanctuaries nearby.

ui.key: |Chicago is a major Midwestern city on Lake Michigan. It is known for its skyscraper architecture, Millennium Park and the Art Institute of Chicago.
ui.ko: 미국 중서부 미시간호 연안의 대도시다. 고층 건축물과 밀레니엄 파크, 시카고 미술관이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: Chicago is a major Midwestern city on Lake Michigan. It is known for its skyscraper architecture, Millennium Park and the Art Institute of Chicago.

ui.en: Clark is a former U.S. air base area in Pampanga in central Luzon. It now has an international airport, golf courses and casino resorts.

ui.key: |Da Nang is a port city on Vietnam’s central coast. It has a long beach, Ba Na Hills and the Marble Mountains, and is close to Hoi An.
ui.ko: 베트남 중부 동해안의 항구 도시다. 긴 해변과 바나힐, 대리석 산이 있으며 호이안과도 가깝다.
ui.en: Da Nang is a port city on Vietnam’s central coast. It has a long beach, Ba Na Hills and the Marble Mountains, and is close to Hoi An.

ui.key: |Dallas is a large city in northern Texas. It is known for historic exhibits tied to President Kennedy, an arts district and cowboy culture.
ui.ko: 미국 텍사스주 북부의 대도시다. 케네디 대통령 관련 역사 전시와 아트 지구, 카우보이 문화가 알려져 있다.

ui.key: |Delhi is India’s capital region, split into Old Delhi and New Delhi. Sights include the Red Fort, Humayun’s Tomb and India Gate.
ui.ko: 인도의 수도권 대도시로 올드델리와 뉴델리로 나뉜다. 붉은 요새와 후마윤 묘, 인도 문 같은 유적이 있다.
ui.en: Delhi is India’s capital region, split into Old Delhi and New Delhi. Sights include the Red Fort, Humayun’s Tomb and India Gate.

ui.key: |Detroit is a Michigan city long at the center of the American auto industry. It is known for The Henry Ford museum and its Motown music heritage.
ui.ko: 미국 미시간주의 도시로 자동차 산업의 중심이었다. 헨리 포드 박물관과 모타운 음악 유산이 알려져 있다.
ui.en: Detroit is a Michigan city long at the center of the American auto industry. It is known for The Henry Ford museum and its Motown music heritage.

ui.key: |Dhaka is the capital of Bangladesh, on the Buriganga River. Old Dhaka’s Mughal-era sites, crowded markets and rickshaw streets give it its character.
ui.ko: 방글라데시의 수도로 부리강가강 변에 있다. 올드 다카의 무굴 시대 유적과 붐비는 시장, 릭샤 거리가 특징이다.
ui.en: Dhaka is the capital of Bangladesh, on the Buriganga River. Old Dhaka’s Mughal-era sites, crowded markets and rickshaw streets give it its character.

ui.key: |Doha is the capital of Qatar, on the Persian Gulf coast. The Museum of Islamic Art, the traditional Souq Waqif and a modern waterfront skyline are the highlights.
ui.ko: 카타르의 수도로 페르시아만 연안에 있다. 이슬람 미술관과 전통 시장 수크 와키프, 현대적 해안 스카이라인이 볼거리다.
ui.en: Doha is the capital of Qatar, on the Persian Gulf coast. The Museum of Islamic Art, the traditional Souq Waqif and a modern waterfront skyline are the highlights.

ui.key: |Dongjin Bridge crosses the water in a quiet landscape. Open views of river and fields surround it.
ui.ko: 경남과 전남의 강이나 바다를 건너는 동진대교다. 주변의 물과 들판 풍경이 열려 있다.
ui.en: Dongjin Bridge crosses the water in a quiet landscape. Open views of river and fields surround it.

ui.key: |Dubai is a Persian Gulf city in the United Arab Emirates. It has the Burj Khalifa, a very tall skyscraper, along with desert excursions and large shopping malls.
ui.ko: 아랍에미리트의 페르시아만 연안 도시다. 세계에서 가장 높은 건물로 알려진 부르즈 할리파와 사막 체험, 대형 쇼핑몰이 있다.
ui.en: Dubai is a Persian Gulf city in the United Arab Emirates. It has the Burj Khalifa, a very tall skyscraper, along with desert excursions and large shopping malls.

ui.key: |Frankfurt is a financial center in Hesse, Germany, on the River Main. It combines a high-rise skyline, the old Römer square and one of Europe’s major airports.
ui.ko: 독일 헤센주의 금융 중심 도시로 마인강 변에 있다. 고층 빌딩 스카이라인과 옛 시청 광장 뢰머, 유럽 주요 공항이 있다.
